r: الفرق بين النفس والروح ما الفرق بين النفس والروح؟ هذا محل خلاف بين اهل العلم، والراجح ان الروح تطلق علي القوه التي بها الحياه، وان النفس تطلق علي باطن الانسان، فالنفس هي ما يسمي بالقلب مثلا، والروح تشمل كل القوي الباطنيه فيدخل فيها النفس القلب والعقل والبصيره وغير ذلك؟ ولهذا فالحيوانات لها ارواح وتقبض عند الموت، ولكن ليس لها تلك القوي ليس لها عقل مثلا، هذا يختص بالانسان. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- الفرق بين اهل السنه والجماعه اهل السنه والجماعه ما الفرق بينهما؟ هذا مصطلح لم يرد في الكتاب ولا في السنه، وانما جاءت احاديث فيها الامر بالسنه واحاديث فيها الامر بالجماعه، فقد ثبت عن رسول الله (ص) في وصيته التي رواها عنه العرباض بن ساريه رضي الله عنه انه قال: «فمن يعش منكم فسيري اختلافا كثيرا فعليكم بسنتي وسنه الخلفاء الراشدين المهديين، عضوا عليها بالنواجذ» وهذا امر منه باتباع السنه، وكذلك جاء عن النبي (ص) الحض علي التزام سنته في كثير من الاحاديث مثل حديث المقدام بن معدي كرب رضي الله عنه ان رسول الله (ص) قال: «الا هل يوشك رجل شعبان متكء علي اريكته ياتيه الامر من امري مما امرت به او نهيت عنه فيقول: بيننا وبينكم كتاب الله، ما وجدنا فيه من حلال استحللناه وما وجدنا فيه من حرام حرمناه، الا وانما حرم رسول الله مثل ما حرم الله، الا اني اوتيت القران ومثله معه». وكذلك جاء عنه (ص) الحض علي الجماعه في احاديث كثيره مثل قوله لحذيفه بن اليمان: تلزم جماعه المسلمين وامامهم، ومثل قوله (ص): لا يحل دم امرء مسلم الا باحدي ثلاث، الثيب الزاني والنفس بالنفس والتارك لدينه المفارق للجماعه، ومثل قوله (ص): من فارق الجماعه شبرا مات ميته جاهليه، ومثل قوله (ص): من فارق الجماعه فقد خلع ربقه الاسلام من عنقه، ومثل قوله (ص): يد الله مع الجماعه ومن شذ شذ في النار، ومثل قوله (ص): من اراد بحبوحه الجنه فليلزم الجماعه، ومثل قوله (ص): يد الله علي الجماعه وانما ياكل الذءب من الغنم القاصيه، وكذلك نهيه عن التعرب بعد الهجره، والاحاديث كثيره في هذا الباب فهذه الاحاديث بمجموعها الاحاديث الاولي الداله علي التزام السنه، والاحاديث الثانيه الداله علي التزام الجماعه لفق بينهما العلماء فجعلوا المحجه البيضاء التي كان عليها النبي (ص) واصحابه السنه والجماعه، فليس المقصود بالسنه مجرد ما يسمي بالسنه في عرف الفقهاء، وهو هيءه الامر الشرعي المامور به امرا غير جازم بحيث يثاب فاعله ولا يعاقب تاركه، هذه السنه عند الفقهاء والاصوليين وليست هي المقصوده هنا، كذلك ليس المقصود بالجماعه الافراد الكثر والسواد الاعظم فقط، بل يقول الله تعالي: {وان تطع اكثر من في الارض يضلوك عن سبيل الله} [الانعام 116] فالمقصود ما كان عليه الرسول (ص) واصحابه فهذا نسميه سنه وجماعه اصطلاحا فقط، ولا مشاحه في الاصطلاح. t: On Obsessive Whispering in Purification and Prayer, and How to Treat It
a: الكلام علي الوسوسه في الطهاره والصلاه وطرق علاجها
b:
i have a son who is seized by obsessive whispering (waswasah) in purification (ṭahārah) and prayer. when he goes to the lavatory and cleans himself of urine, he performs ablution right through to the end, and then says: i have not got free of the urine, and i cannot pray with substantive impurity (najāsah) on me — and he takes off all his clothing, takes other clothing, and prays.

this kind of thing is from the work of satan. god, exalted, has said: {o you who believe, do not follow the footsteps of satan} (sūrat al-nūr 24:21). so he must treat himself for this illness with the means of healing given in the revealed law. among them: frequent seeking of forgiveness. among them likewise: the remembrances for entering the lavatory and for leaving it, and keeping to them. among them also: not wearying himself by thinking much about this matter — he is obliged to turn it away from himself. among them also: the lawful incantation (ruqyah), that he recite the qur'an over himself and that someone else recite it over him. among them: keeping to the remembrances for sleeping and waking, and for morning and evening. and among them: the voluntary charity (ṣadaqah) by which illness is treated — 'treat your sick with charity.' all of that will remove this obsessive whispering from him, by god's leave.
r: عندي ولد تاخذه الوسوسه في الطهاره و الصلاه فاذا ذهب الي الخلاء و تطهر من البول يتوضا حتي ينتهي فيقول انا لم اخلص من البول و لا اقدر علي ان اصلي بالنجاسه و ينزع لباسه كله و ياخذ لباسا اخر و يصلي؟ ان هذا النوع هو من عمل الشيطان و قد قال الله تعالي:﴿يايها الذين امنوا لا تتبعوا خطوات الشيطان﴾ فعليه ان يتعالج من هذا المرض باسباب الشفاء الشرعيه و منها الاكثار من الاستغفار و منها كذلك اذكار دخول الخلاء و الخروج منه و الحفاظ عليها و منها ايضا عدم اتعاب النفس في التفكير كثيرا في هذا الامر فيجب عليه ان يصرفه عن نفسه و منها ايضا الرقيه الشرعيه ان يقرا القران علي نفسه و ان يقراه عليه غيره و منها الحفاظ علي اذكار النوم و الاستيقاظ و الصباح و المساء و منها الصدقه التي يعالج بها المرض «عالجوا مرضاكم بالصدقه» فكل ذلك يزيل عنه هذا الوسواس باذن الله

t: On Breaks in the Customary Order
a: الكلام علي خوارق العادات
b:
what appears of extraordinary events at the hand of the friend of god, and what appears at the hand of the sorcerer — what is the difference between them?

the scholars have mentioned that breaks in the customary order are of seven kinds: four of them for good and three of them for evil.

the four that are for good are, first, the precursors (irhāṣāt) that appear at the birth of the prophets and in their childhood — such as the cracking of the arch of chosroes, the dying down of the fire of the persians, what halimah witnessed of extraordinary things in the childhood of the prophet, upon whom be peace, the opening of his breast, and the like. these are not miracles (muʿjizāt) but precursors; they point to his being sent, since at that time he had not yet been sent — he was sent at the completion of forty years.

the second kind is the miracles: what appears at the hand of the prophets at the point of challenge, in conveying the messages of their lord — such as the descent of revelation, the ascension and the night journey, the splitting of the moon and the like, and such as the she-camel of salih and the staff of moses. this is the miracle, and it belongs to the prophets alone.

the third kind is what is called the charisms of the friends of god (karāmāt al-awliyāʾ): what god honours with it whoever is of the people of obedience, god-consciousness (taqwā) and faith, from among the things that help him toward obedience — such as bodily strength, so that a person is able to keep up ablution and full washing; this is a charism with which god honours his friends. of the same kind is keeping to the first row, or to answering the one who calls to prayer, or to praying in congregation, or to completing the qur'an every day and night, for example, or keeping to the night prayer through the whole year. this is a charism with which god honours whom he wills of his friends, and it is a break with the custom of most people. this kind is called the charisms, and most of them are not directed toward this world but toward the affairs of the hereafter. charisms are in most cases not directed toward worldly matters, such as a person finding money or a car or a telephone or the like; those are trivial worldly matters, whereas god's honouring of his servants is bound up with matters greater than this — as when he honours his friends with what helps them toward his worship and his obedience, and with what increases them in faith, awe and god-consciousness.

the fourth kind is what is called assistance (ʿawn): what is attained by the middling sort of muslims, who are not renowned for obedience or for worship, so that god ordains for such a person something that breaks the customary order on account of his faith — like one whose mount bolted from him in an empty tract of land and a tree held it back for him. this kind is among what gives help in worldly matters; it does not fall within the scope of the charism, but is of the assistance by which god assists his servants, ordaining for them what helps them in their worldly affairs, of what breaks the customary order.

these are the four for good. as for the three that are for evil: the first is what is called humiliation (ihānah), namely the extraordinary events that appear at the hand of a false claimant to messengerhood, contrary to his claim. musaylimah the liar heard that the prophet, upon whom be peace, had wiped the head of a boy and that the boy did not go grey — his hair stayed black until he died an old man. so musaylimah wiped the head of a boy, and the boy went bald. and he heard that the prophet, upon whom be peace, spat into a well that was salt and it became sweet; so he spat into a well and it dried up. this kind is called humiliation: it is in fact a break in the customary order — this is a break in the customary order, but it is a humiliation, because it is not in the manner sought, and is the opposite of the manner the person seeks.

the second kind of these breaks that are for evil is sorcery (siḥr). sorcery is what has already been defined, in its two kinds: what is illusion, and what is actual effect. by it a break in the customary order comes about, and it is for evil; it is unbelief on the part of the one who does it.

the third kind of the breaks that are for evil is what is called soothsaying (kihānah) and consorting with the jinn. the jinn break the customary order for the human being: they hear a single word from the unseen and add to it ninety-nine lies, so they bring him a hundred words, among which is one word of truth and ninety-nine lies. then he reports what they have reported to him, so that at one time a truthful one comes to him and at another a lying one — as saf ibn sayyad said to the messenger of god, upon whom be peace, when he asked him, as is in the ṣaḥīḥ. he said: 'what comes to you, saf?' he said: 'a truthful one and a lying one come to me.' he said: 'be off with you; you will never go beyond your measure.' so the prophet, upon whom be peace, knew that what comes to him is from satan, because what is from god has no liar in it — it must be truthful. so he said, 'a truthful one and a lying one come to me', and he said: 'be off with you; you will never go beyond your measure.'

these, then, are the breaks in the customary order. their divisions are clear and the distinction between them is plain. what causes difficulty for some people is only what happens to some of the friends of god: that they report certain things of the unseen, being people of uprightness and righteousness, and at times they are right in that and at times they are wrong. the answer to this is that they are obliged not to report what they have come upon of that; it is forbidden (ḥarām) for them to report it. and if they do report some of it and it turns out true, the people of faith must not be taken in by it, and must know that this happens to the righteous and to the corrupt, and happens to the believer and to others.

r: ما يظهر من الخوارق علي يد الولي وما يظهر علي يد الساحر ما الفرق بينهما؟ ان اهل العلم ذكروا ان خوارق العادات سبعه اقسام، اربع منها للخير وثلاث للشر، فالاربع التي للخير هي اولا الارهاصات التي تظهر عند ميلاد الانبياء وفي صباهم كتصدع ايوان كسري وخمود نار الفرس وما شاهدته حليمه من الخوارق في صبا النبي (ص) وشق صدره ونحوه فهذه امور ليست من المعجزات ولكنها من الارهاصات فهي تدل علي بعثته، فهو اذ ذاك لم يبعث بعد، وانما بعث علي راس اربعين سنه، والنوع الثاني هو المعجزات، وهي ما يظهر علي يد الانبياء عند التحدي عند تبليغ رسالات ربهم، كنزول الوحي، وكالمعراج والاسراء وشق القمر ونحو ذلك وكناقه صالح وعصا موسي فهذا هو المعجزه وهي مختصه بالانبياء، القسم الثالث ما يسمي بكرامات الاولياء، وهو ما يكرم الله به من كان من اهل الطاعه والتقوي والايمان مما يعينه علي الطاعه، كقوه البدن بحيث يستطيع الانسان الدوام علي الوضوء والغسل، فهذا كرامه يكرم الله بها اولياءه، ومثل ذلك الحفاظ علي الصف الاول او علي اجابه المنادي او علي الصلاه في الجماعه او علي ختم القران في كل يوم وليله مثلا او الحفاظ علي قيام الليل في طيله السنه، فهذا كرامه يكرم الله بها من شاء من اولياءه وهي خارقه لعاده جمهور الناس، فهذا النوع يسمي الكرامات، واغلبها لا يتجه الي الدنيا انما يتجه الي امور الاخره، فالكرامات في اغلبها لا تتجه الي امور الدنيا كان يجد الانسان نقودا او سياره او هاتفا او نحو ذلك فهذه امور دنيويه تافهه واكرام الله تعالي للعباد يتعلق بامور اكبر من هذا كاكرامه لاولياءه بما يعينهم علي عبادته وطاعته وما يزيدهم ايمانا وخشيه وتقوي، النوع الرابع هو ما يسمي بالعون، وهو ما يناله اواسط المسلمين ممن ليس مشهورا بالطاعه ولا بالعباده فيقيض الله له امرا خارقا للعاده بسبب ايمانه، كمن نفرت منه راحلته بخلاء من الارض فامسكتها عليه شجره، فهذا النوع مما يعين علي امور الدنيا ليس داخلا في نطاق الكرامه ولكنه من العون يعين الله بها عباده، فيقيض لهم ما يعينهم علي امور دنياهم مما هو خارق للعاده، هذه الاربع للخير اما الثلاث التي للشر فهي اولا ما يسمي بالاهانه، وهو ما يظهر من الخوارق علي يد مدعي الرساله الكاذب علي خلاف دعواه، فمسيلمه الكذاب سمع ان النبي (ص) مسح علي راس صبي فلم يشب، بقي شعره اسود الي ان مات وهو شيخ كبير، فمسح هو علي راس صبي فقرع، وسمع ان النبي (ص) بصق في بير كانت ملحا فصارت عذبا، فبصق هو في بير فيبست، فهذا النوع يسمي اهانه هو خارق للعاده فعلا، هذا خارق للعاده لكنه اهانه لانه ليس علي الوجه المطلوب وهو خلاف الوجه الذي يطلبه الانسان، النوع الثاني من هذه الخوارق التي هي للشر السحر، والسحر هو ما سبق تعريفه بقسميه، ما كان منه تخييلا وما كان تاثيرا، فهذا يحصل به خرق للعاده وهو للشر فهو كفر بصاحبه، والنوع الثالث من الخوارق التي هي للشر ما كان مما يسمي بالكهانه ومخالطه الجن، فالجن يخرقون العاده للانسان فيسمعون الكلمه الواحده من الغيب فيضيفون اليها تسعا وتسعين كذبه، فياتونه بماءه كلمه فيها كلمه واحده صدق وتسعه وتسعون كذبه، فيخبر هو بما اخبروه به، فتاره ياتيه صادق وتاره ياتيه كاذب، كما قال صاف بن صياد لرسول الله (ص) عندما ساله كما في الصحيح، قال: ماذا ياتيك يا صاف؟ قال: ياتيني صادق وكاذب، قال: اخسا فلن تعدو قدرك، فعرف النبي (ص) انما ياتيه هو من الشيطان لان ما كان من عند الله لا يكون فيه كاذب، لا بد ان يكون صادقا، فقال: ياتيني صادق وكاذب فقال: اخسا فلن تعدو قدرك، فاذن هذه هي خوارق العاده واقسامها واضحه والتمييز بينها بين، وانما يشكل علي بعض الناس ما يحصل لبعض الاولياء من الاخبار ببعض المغيبات وهم اهل استقامه وصلاح وتاره يصدقون في ذلك وتاره يكذبون، والجواب عن هذا انه يجب عليهم ان لا يخبروا بما اطلعوا عليه من ذلك، ويحرم عليهم الاخبار به، واذا اخبروا ببعضه فكان صادقا فعلي اهل الايمان ان لا يغتروا به وان يعلموا ان هذا يحصل للصالح والطالح ويحصل للمءمن وغيره، ولذلك سءل الامام الجنيد رحمه الله فقيل له: الولي هو الذي يطير في الهواء؟ قال: الغراب يطير في الهواء وينقر الدبر، قيل له: اهو الذي يمشي علي الماء؟ قال: الحوت يمشي علي الماء وتءكل ميتته، قيل: اهو الذي يجمع بين المشرق والمغرب في ان واحد؟ قال: ابليس يجمع بين المشرق والمغرب في ان واحد وهو اخس خلق الله، قيل: فما الولي اذن؟ قال: من استقام حاله علي وفق ما جاء به رسول الله (ص) من عند الله تعالي فهذا هو الولي وهذه هي الولايه التي يحرص عليها هي ولايه الله.

t: Fatwas on Creed
a: فتاوي في العقيده
b:
obsessive whispering concerning creed

what is the ruling concerning one who is exposed to satan's obsessive whisperings in his creed? what is he advised to do?

when a person senses anything of satan's whispering in what he believes, he must know that this is one of the footsteps of satan, which god, exalted, has forbidden us to follow, for god, exalted, has said: {o you who believe, do not follow the footsteps of satan} (sūrat al-nūr 24:21). he must make much remembrance of god, exalted, for that drives satan away. so let him make much seeking of forgiveness, and let him say 'there is no god but god', for this cuts off satan's path and removes those whisperings entirely. and he must not pursue the thought: if a passing thought comes, he must not turn it over again, but should cut it off with the remembrance of god, exalted...

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

by what are creed and the foundations of religion established?

are creed and the foundations of religion established by a singly transmitted report (khabar al-āḥād)?

the singly transmitted report is of four types in the usage of the hadith scholars. the first of them is the widespread (mustafīḍ), which comes close to the mass-transmitted (mutawātir); separating the two is laborious. by this, creedal doctrines are established without disagreement. the second is the well-known (mashhūr), which is what a number narrated in every layer, not exceeding ten and not falling below three or four. next to it is the strong (ʿazīz), which is what two or three alone narrated in one of the layers. next to it is the singular (gharīb), which is what one narrator alone narrated in one layer, in whichever of its layers that may be.

over these three, people differed as to whether they yield certainty or not. the majority of the legal theorists held that a singly transmitted report, whether well-known, strong or singular, does not yield certainty. the verifying scholars among them held that it does yield certainty if it is attended by indications that point to it. others held that it yields certainty absolutely, and this is narrated from the majority of the hadith scholars. but the correct position is that singly transmitted reports, if they are attended by indications, do yield certainty; and the hadith scholars give as their example of this what malik narrates from nafi from ibn umar from the messenger of god, upon whom be peace, for it yields certainty on account of the indications attending it.

on this disagreement, they differed over taking singly transmitted reports as evidence in creedal doctrines. creedal doctrines divide into two kinds: what certainty is required in, namely the foundations of the creeds and of the religions; and what certainty is not required in, namely their details — such as the details of the attributes of god, glorified and exalted, and the like. the details of the attributes, on the stronger view, do not have certainty as a condition, and therefore singly transmitted reports are accepted in them. so it is possible for an attribute to be established for god, mighty and majestic, by a singly transmitted report, and it is possible for a name to be established for him by that.

that is why al-suyuti, may god have mercy on him, says: *his names, glorified be he, are fixed by revelation; a third position holds it of the name only, not of the attribute. and a single instance suffices, and the verbal noun, and the verb, and the suppositions, in the view of the one whose opinion counts.* 'the suppositions' means singly transmitted reports.

as for matters of certainty, and the foundations — the foundations of the religions — certainty is indispensable in them. so on the view that a singly transmitted report yields certainty absolutely, there is no difficulty in their being established by it. and on the view that it yields certainty if attended by indications, the same holds — as with what al-bukhari narrated in the ṣaḥīḥ, or what muslim narrated in the ṣaḥīḥ: even if it were singular or strong, there attend it such indications as require certainty about it. and if certainty is stipulated in them, then a singly transmitted report is not taken in them.

our ruling of soundness on what is in the two ṣaḥīḥs is not intended as certainty in the view of the legal theorists; it is intended as certainty only in the view of the hadith scholars. that is why al-iraqi, may god have mercy on him, said in the alfiyyah on hadith terminology: *by 'sound' and 'weak' they intended [a judgement] on the outward, not certainty; and what is relied upon is our refraining from ruling of any chain that it is the soundest absolutely. some people have ventured upon it, and it was said: malik, from nafi, the client of the devout one, in what the latter narrated. and choose, where it is given with a chain from him, al-shafi'i; i said: and from him, ahmad.*
r: الوسوسه في العقيده ما حكم من يتعرض لوساوس الشيطان في عقيدته؟ بما ذا ينصح؟ علي الانسان اذا احس بشيء من وسوسه الشيطان في اعتقاده ان يعلم ان ذلك من خطوات الشيطان التي نهانا الله تعالي عن اتباعها فقد قال الله تعالي:﴿يايها الذين امنوا لا تتبعوا خطوات الشيطان﴾ . و عليه ان يكثر من ذكر الله تعالي فان ذلك يطرد الشيطان فليكثر من الاستغفار و ليقل \"لا اله الا الله\" فهذا يقطع علي الشيطان السبيل و يزيل تلك الوساوس بالكليه و عليه ان لا يتبع التفكير التفكير، اذا جاءت فكره خاطره عليه ان لا يرددها، بل يقطعها بذكر الله تعالي... t: Defining the People of Kalām
a: تعريف اهل الكلام
b:
who are the people of kalām, and what do you mean by them?

'the people of kalām' is a name that has become well known as applied to a group of this community who laid down rules for the standards that govern the intellect. that is because the lawgiver referred knowledge of some matters to the intellect, while people's understandings are disparate and divergent, and it is not possible to make any one of them a proof against the rest. so there was a need to lay down criteria and controls to which people could refer when their intellects diverge.

you know that god's distribution of intellects among people is uneven. that is why the sages say: there is no one who is not content with god as regards his own intellect, and those with the least intellect are the most content with it. the person with the smallest share of intellect thinks he is the most intelligent of people — and this is part of god's wisdom, exalted, and his kindness. so how can judgement be referred to this intellect, in which people vary? controls must be laid down to which reference can be made.

these controls are what are called the proofs and the demonstrations, and the propositions, which are the claims. their basis is the distinction between assent (taṣdīq) and conception (taṣawwur): conception is the grasping of a single notion, and assent is the grasping of a relation — that is, the affirming of one thing of another, or the denying of it.

these rational rules are pure exercise of reasoning; they cannot be a hundred per cent wrong, nor a hundred per cent right. error has occurred in many of their aspects, and especially when the theories of the greeks and the theories of the romans were translated into them; and there is no doubt that the theories of these earlier nations are mixed with much that is pagan and much that associates partners with god.

likewise, many of those who studied the science of kalām and went deep into these rules went to excess concerning the intellect, until they took it out of its proper bounds. the intellect is one of the faculties of the human being; it is like his eye, his ear and his hand, and there can be no going to excess in it, because it has limits at the upper end and limits at the lower end. its limits at the lower end are the primary truths, the observed, the intuited, the sensed and the widely held — these are the lower bound of the intellect. its upper ceiling is the nine points at which intellects come to a halt, which are gathered in the phrase 'ʿajil wa-qatab': the ʿayn is for the absence of both contradictories; the jīm is for joining the two together; the lām is for the necessity of circularity or of infinite regress; the wāw is for the occurrence of a number without end; the qāf is for the reversal of a reality; the tāʾ is for the multiplicity of the agent, and for the obtaining of what already obtains, and likewise for preponderance without a preponderating factor; and the bāʾ is for the collapse of an exhaustive division.

these are nine: they are the points at which intellects come to a halt. and if intellects are like this, then we cannot go to excess concerning them, nor make them the thing to which judgement is referred in all matters. rather, the ruling upon a person is god's address, not the address of the intellect.

from here, many of the theologians err in how they conceive the intellect. that is why al-ghazali, may god have mercy on him, said: revelation is an intellect from without, and the intellect is a revelation from within. there is no doubt that this is part of going to excess concerning the intellect, because the intellect al-ghazali is speaking of is not embodied in the intellect of any particular person — he does not mean the intellect of abu hamid al-ghazali, for instance, or the intellect of a particular human being; rather he means absolute existence, which is the mental existence of the intellect, and he does not mean external existence, embodied in the intellect of one person among persons or one group among groups. and when a judgement is passed on a mental quiddity rather than an external one, it is not a precise judgement.

likewise, part of what has become mixed into what is called the science of kalām is plunging into the attributes of god, exalted, without knowledge — and this is an obliterating danger, because god, exalted: {vision does not grasp him, and he grasps vision; and he is the subtle, the aware (103)} [الأنعام] (sūrat al-anʿām 6:103). we mentioned in the previous lesson that nothing can be affirmed of him except what he has affirmed of himself, or what his messenger, upon whom be peace, affirmed of him; so the knowledge of an originated being cannot reach him — indeed nothing can be known about him except what he has revealed. and if the matter is so, then there is no scope for the intellect in this chapter.

the people of kalām are many groups, and they entered a number of sciences. in the language sciences there is a theologising faction, the one called the people of rational rule-making, and they are the people of kufa. the people of kufa, for instance, when they find any rare linguistic form, draw an analogy upon it and make it a rule; whereas the people of basra lay down a rule by the majority usage, and whatever contradicts it they treat as anomalous, or else they seek an interpretation of it that returns it to the original rule. an example is their disagreement over whether the agent may precede. the people of basra say the agent does not precede: *and after a verb comes an agent; if it appears, that is it, and otherwise a pronoun lies concealed.* but the kufans say no, a preceding agent does exist; and the basrans say that where such a thing is found, it is the agent of an omitted verb indicated by what comes after it.

likewise in legal theory (uṣūl al-fiqh). in legal theory there is a school called the theological school, which builds the principles of legal theory, and the rules of derivation and of drawing on the tex
r: من هم اهل الكلام وماذا تعنون بهم؟ اهل الكلام اسم اشتهر اطلاقه علي طاءفه من هذه الامه وضعت قواعد لضوابط العقول، وذلك ان الشارع احال علم بعض الامور علي العقل وعلوم الناس متفاوته متباينه، ولا يمكن ان يجعل واحد منها حجه علي باقيها، فاحتيج الي وضع معايير وضوابط يرجع اليها الناس عند تخالف عقولهم وانتم تعلمون ان توزيع الله سبحانه وتعالي للعقول بين الناس متباين، ولذلك يقول الحكماء: ما من احد الا وهو راض عن الله في عقله، واقلهم عقلا ارضاهم به، اقل الناس نصيبا من العقل يظن انه اعقل الناس، وهذا من حكمه الله تعالي ولطفه، فكيف يتحاكم الي هذا العقل الذي يتفاوت الناس فيه لا بد من وضع ضوابط يرجع اليها، وهذه الضوابط هي التي سميت بالحجج والبراهين وبالقضايا التي هي الدعاوي، ومبناها علي التفريق بين التصديق والتصور، فالتصور هو ادراك المفرد والتصديق هو ادراك النسبه اي اثبات امر لامر او نفيه عنه، وهذه القواعد العقليه هي من الاجتهاد المحض، ولا يمكن ان تكون خطا ماءه بالماءه ولا صوابا ماءه بالماءه، وقد حصل الخطا في كثير من جوانبها وبالاخص حين ترجمت اليها نظريات اليونان الاغريق ونظريات الرومان، ولا شك ان نظريات هذه الامم السابقه يخالطها كثير من الوثنيات والشركيات، وكذلك فان كثيرا من الذين درسوا علم الكلام وتعمقوا في هذه القواعد غلوا في العقل حتي اخرجوه عن طوره، والعقل جارحه من جوارح الانسان فهو مثل عينه واذنه ويده ولا يمكن الغلو فيه لان له حدودا الي اعلي وحدودا الي اسفل، فحدوده الي اسفل هي الاوليات والمشاهدات والحدسيات والمحسوسات والمشهورات فهذه هي الحد الادني للعقل والسقف الاعلي له هي مواقف العقول التسعه التي يجمعها قوله: عجل وقتب، فالعين للعرو من النقيضين، والجيم لجمعهما، واللام للزوم الدور اوالتسلسل والواو لوقوع عدد لا نهايه له، والقاف لقلب الحقيقه، والتاء لتعدد الفاعل وتحصيل الحاصل وكذلك لترجيح بلا مرجح، والباء لبطلان الحصر، فهذه تسعه هي مواقف العقول التي تقف عندها فاذا كانت العقول كذلك فلا يمكن ان نغلو فيها او نجعلها يتحاكم اليها في كل الامور بل الحكم للشخص هو خطاب الله لا خطاب العقل، ومن هنا فان كثيرا من المتكلمين يغلطون في تصور العقل، ولذلك قال الغزالي رحمه الله: الوحي عقل من الخارج والعقل وحي من الداخل، ولا شك ان هذا من الغلو في العقل، لان العقل الذي يتكلم عنه الغزالي ليس متمثلا في عقل شخص بعينه، فلا يقصد عقل ابي حامد الغزالي مثلا، او عقل انسان بعينه،بل يقصد الوجود المطلق الذي هو الوجود الذهني للعقل، ولا يقصد الوجود الخارجي المتمثل في عقل شخص من الاشخاص او جماعه من الجماعات، واذا كان الحكم علي ماهيه ذهنيه غير خارجيه فهو حكم غير دقيق، كذلك فان مما خالط ما يسمي بعلم الكلام الخوض في صفات الله تعالي بغير علم، وهذا من الخطر الماحق، لان الله تعالي: {لا تدركه الابصار وهو يدرك الابصار وهو اللطيف الخبير (103)} [الانعام] وقد ذكرنا في الدرس الماضي انه لا يمكن ان يثبت له الا ما اثبته لنفسه او اثبته له رسوله (ص) فلا يمكن ان يصل علم الحادث اليه، بل لا يمكن ان يعلم عنه الا ما اوحي به، واذا كان الامر كذلك فلا مجال للعقل في هذا الباب، واهل الكلام فرق كثيره دخلت علوما متعدده، ففي علوم اللغه طاءفه متكلمه وهي التي تسمي باهل التقعيد العقلي وهم اهل الكوفه، فاهل الكوفه مثلا اذا وجدوا اي نادره لغويه قاسوا عليها وجعلوها قاعده، واهل البصره يضعون قاعده بالاكثريه وما خالفها جعلوه من الشواذ، او بحثوا له عن تاويل يرده الي القاعده الاصليه، مثل خلافهم في تقدم الفاعل، فان اهل البصره يقولون الفاعل لا يتقدم: وبعد فعل فاعل فان ظهر** فهو والا فضمير استتر لكن الكوفيين يقولون لا، بل يوجد فاعل متقدم، والبصريون يقولون: اذا وجد فانه فاعل فعل محذوف يدل عليه ما بعده، وكذلك في الاصول، ففي الاصول مدرسه تسمي المدرسه الكلاميه وهي التي تبني القواعد الاصوليه وقواعد الاستنباط واستغلال النصوص الشرعيه علي مقتضي القوانين العقليه، وهذه المدرسه هي التي سلكت في المذاهب الثلاثه المذهب المالكي والمذهب الشافعي والمذهب الحنبلي، وخالفتها مدرسه تسمي مدرسه الفقهاء وهي مدرسه الحنفيه، فانهم اعتمدوا علي التفريع الفقهي ولم يعتمدوا علي ترتيب المقدمات المنطقيه العقليه، وكذلك دخل هذا العلم في علم العقاءد ووضع فيه كثير من الكتب واشتهر كثير من الفرق الداخله في مسمي الكلام، مثل الكلابيه اصحاب ابن كلاب، والكراميه اصحاب ابن كرام، وكذلك الي حد ما الماتريديه والاشعريه اي اتباع هذين الامامين، فكثير منهم ايضا دخلوا في علم الكلام وتوغلوا فيه، وكذلك في التفسير فان بعض المفسرين يدخلون في مسمي اهل الكلام لانشغالهم بالتفسير العقلي بالراي المحض، ومن ذلك التفسير الاشاري الذي اشتغل به الالوسي رحمه الله تعالي وادرجه في اخر تفسير كل ايه من تفسيره تقريبا.

t: The Reality of Unveiling
a: حقيقه الكشف
b:
what is the reality of unveiling (kashf), and to whom does it occur?

unveiling means that god, exalted, unveils to some of his servants something of the relative unseen. the unseen is of two kinds. there is a real unseen, and this is not unveiled to anyone, because it is of god's knowledge which he has kept to himself, as god, exalted, said: {and with him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them but he} [الأنعام 59] (sūrat al-anʿām 6:59). and the prophet, upon whom be peace, said, concerning five which none knows but god: {indeed, god — with him is knowledge of the hour; and he sends down the rain; and he knows what is in the wombs. and no soul knows what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die} [لقمان 34] (sūrat luqmān 31:34). this real unseen — no created being has any access to it, and it is among the exclusive properties of the deity, majestic is his majesty.

the second kind is the relative unseen: that which some servants come to know and others do not. coming to know it by the accustomed means is not a break with the customary order — as with a physician's coming to know the state of the foetus in its mother's belly, that it is alive and breathing, or that it is male or female, or the like, by means of imaging. this is coming to know by ordinary things; just as when a sheep is slaughtered and skinned and its belly is opened and there is a foetus in it: before it was uncovered it was a relative unseen, and after it was uncovered it became part of the world of the witnessed. this is of the kind of the relative unseen.

likewise, whoever is behind this wall now is not seen by the one on the other side of it; but this unseen is a relative unseen, because if he comes in through the door he sees them, and what had been hidden from him is unveiled to him. and likewise what occurs by means of devices, such as speaking by telephone with a distant person, or seeing him by means of satellites, or by video telephone. this is of the relative unseen, and its discovery in that case, by the accustomed means, is not a break with the customary order.

but its being unveiled by a break with the customary order, with no means at all that we can see — this is unveiling in the sense of a break with the customary order: that a person sees what others do not see in ordinary matters. for instance, if a person looks through a magnifying glass and sees a crescent moon or a distant star, that is not a break with the customary order, because a relative unseen was unveiled to him by an instrument and a means; but if he sees it without an instrument, then that is a break with the customary order, and it is an unveiling of that relative unseen.

this unveiling may be a charism with which god honours some of his friends, disclosing to them certain matters that increase them in faith and in awe of god, and in greater reliance upon him and love for him. and it may be a trial, as god tries with it some of the deluded, disclosing to them some of the relative unseen, so that they take themselves to be disposing of the universe, or to be exercising an influence that is not theirs, and so make false and lying claims. this is a trial upon them.

the like of this happens to the believer and to the unbeliever. this unveiling happens to believers, and happens to unbelievers, and happens to one who makes no claim to islam at all: many of the christians and the jews have this kind of unveiling happen to them. and the greatest of it as a trial upon the people of the earth is what happens of it to the false messiah.

for the false messiah has the most astonishing unveilings happen to him. he shows a person his father and his mother, who died some time ago, and lets him hear their speech. he passes by the ruined village and its treasures follow him like swarms of bees. he comes to the people of a village who are in drought and they believe him, so he commands the sky and it rains, and commands the earth and it brings forth growth, and their livestock come home to them in the evening with their udders fuller than they have ever been. and he passes by the people of a village who are in plenty and they call him a liar, so he commands the sky and it withholds, and commands the earth and it is stripped bare, and their livestock come home to them in the severest hardship. this is of the unveilings that happen to the false messiah.

by this it is known that unveiling is not one of the signs of friendship with god — that it happens to believers and happens to unbelievers, and happens to the enemies of god and happens to the friends of god, each according to what god gives him of it. what happens of it to the friends of god is what increases them in faith, in reliance upon god and in love for him; this is what constitutes a charism. as for what is not like that — such as what increases a person in overweening insolence, and his claiming that he disposes of the universe — this is not a praiseworthy unveiling, and is not a charism.
r: ما هي حقيقه الكشف ولمن يكون؟ ان الكشف معناه ان يكشف الله تعالي لبعض عباده شيءا من الغيوب النسبيه، فالغيب قسمان غيب حقيقي وهذا لا يكشف لاحد لانه من علم الله الذي استاثر به كما قال الله تعالي: {وعنده مفاتح الغيب لا يعلمها الا هو}[الانعام 59] وقال النبي (ص) في خمس لا يعلمهن الا الله: {ان الله عنده علم الساعه وينزل الغيث ويعلم ما في الارحام وما تدري نفس ماذا تكسب غدا وما تدري نفس باي ارض تموت}[لقمان 34] فهذا الغيب الحقيقي لا اطلاع لاحد من المخلوقات عليه وهو من خصاءص الاله جل جلاله، النوع الثاني هو الغيب النسبي وهو الذي يطلع عليه بعض العباد دون بعض، فالاطلاع عليه بالوساءل المعهوده غير خارق للعاده، كاطلاع الطبيب علي حال الجنين في بطن امه انه حي يتنفس، او انه ذكر او انثي او نحو ذلك بواسطه الاشعه فهذا اطلاع بامور عاديه كما اذا ذبحت الشاه وسلخت فشق بطنها فاذا فيه جنين فقد كان قبل الكشف عليه غيبا نسبيا وبعد الكشف عليه اصبح من عالم الشهاده، فهذا النوع من الغيوب النسبيه، ومثل ذلك من كان وراء هذا الجدار الان لا يري من دونه، لكن هذا الغيب غيب نسبي لانه اذا دخل من الباب راهم فانكشف له ما كان مغيبا عنه، ومثل ذلك ما يحصل عن طريق الاجهزه كالكلام بالهاتف مع انسان بعيد، او رءيته عن طريق الاقمار الصناعه، او بالهاتف المرءي فهذا من الغيب النسبي واكتشافه حينءذ بالوساءل المعتاده غير خارق للعاده، اما انكشافه بالخارق للعاده من غير وساءل اصلا نراها، فهذا هو الكشف بمعني خرق العاده، ان يري الانسان ما لا يراه غيره في الامور العاديه، مثلا اذا نظر الانسان بمكبر فراي هلالا او نجما بعيدا هذا غير خارق للعاده لانه كشف له غيب نسبي باله ووسيله اذا راه من غير اله فهذا خارق للعاده فهو كشف لذلك الغيب النسبي، وهذا الكشف قد يكون كرامه يكرم الله بها بعض اولياءه فيطلعهم علي بعض الامور التي تزيدهم ايمانا وخشيه لله وزياده توكل عليه ومحبه له، وقد يكون فتنه كما يبتلي الله به بعض المخرفين فيطلعهم علي بعض الغيوب النسبيه فيرون بذلك انهم يتصرفون في الكون او انهم يءثرون بما ليس لهم، فيدعون الدعاوي الباطله الكاذبه فهذا فتنه عليهم، ومثل ذلك يحصل للمءمن والكافر، فهذا الكشف يحصل للمءمنين ويحصل للكافرين ويحصل لمن لا يدعي الاسلام اصلا، كثير من النصاري واليهود يحصل لهم هذا النوع من الكشوف، واعظمه فتنه علي اهل الارض ما يحصل منه للمسيح الدجال، فالمسيح الدجال يحصل له من الكشوف الشيء العجيب جدا، فيري الانسان والده وامه وقد ماتا من فتره ويسمعه كلامهما ويمر علي القريه الخربه فتتبعه كنوزها كيعاسيب النحل وياتي اهل القريه وهم مسنتون فيصدقونه فيامر السماء فتمطر ويامر الارض فتنبت، فتروح عليهم ماشيتهم اسمن ما كانت ضروعا، ويمر علي اهل قريه وهم في خصب فيكذبونه فيامر السماء فتمسك ويامر الارض فتقلع فتروح عليهم ماشيتهم وهي في اشد اللاواء، فهذا من الكشوفات التي تحصل للمسيح الدجال، وبهذا يعلم ان الكشف ليس علامه من علامات الولايه لله، انه يحصل للمءمنين ويحصل للكافرين ويحصل لاعداء الله ويحصل لاولياء الله كل بحسب ما يءتيه الله منه، وما يحصل منه لاولياء الله هو ما يزيدهم ايمانا وتوكلا علي الله ومحبه له فهذا هو الذي يكون كرامه، اما ما ليس كذلك كما يزيد الانسان طغيانا وان يدعي انه يتصرف في الكون فهذا ليس كشفا محمودا وليس كرامه.

t: Various Fatwas
a: فتاوي متنوعه
b:
the ruling on enjoining right and forbidding wrong where a woman is concerned

is it permissible for a woman to enjoin right and forbid wrong?

yes; rather she is obliged to enjoin right and forbid wrong. and it is likewise obligatory that right be enjoined upon her: it is obligatory upon men, if they see a wrong among the women, to forbid the wrong and to enjoin the right. the messenger of god, upon whom be peace, used to undertake that himself. in the two ṣaḥīḥs: he delivered the eid sermon, and thought that the women had not heard him, so he leaned upon bilal and stood over the women and admonished them, and said: 'o company of women, give charity, for i have seen you to be the majority of the people of the fire.' so the women wept, and bilal spread out his garment, and the women began reaching with their hands to their jewellery and throwing it into bilal's garment.

------------------------------------------------------------

the ruling on certain remembrances not transmitted from the messenger of god ﷺ and tied to particular occasions

here is a sheet with remembrances written on it, distributed as photocopies, and on it is that this is the glorification for the month of ramadan, and that on the first day one says, a hundred times: 'glory be to the one whom the heavens glorify with their farthest reaches.'

this kind of thing is innovation (bidʿah), and is among what god has not given leave for and what the messenger of god, upon whom be peace, did not bring. for that reason it must be abandoned and left, and in what the messenger of god, upon whom be peace, brought there is sufficiency to dispense with the like of this...

------------------------------------------------------------

the ruling on hanging amulets

is the one who hangs an amulet an associator of partners with god?

this is lesser association (shirk aṣghar), not greater association — unless he believes that it benefits him and lifts harm from him, in which case that is greater association, by virtue of the belief. but merely hanging it is lesser association, which does not take one out of the religion, like swearing by other than god and the like. for the prophet, upon whom be peace, said: 'whoever hangs an amulet is consigned to it'; and he said: 'whoever hangs an amulet — may god not bring anything to completion for him'; and he said: 'whoever hangs anything is consigned to it'; and he likewise said: 'incantations, amulets and love-charms are association.' what is meant by that is an association below association, and it does not take one out of the religion.

------------------------------------------------------------

the ruling on al-kazānah

what is the ruling on what is called al-kazānah, of whatever kind it may be?

god has kept the unseen to himself. he said: {knower of the unseen; and he does not disclose his unseen to anyone} (sūrat al-jinn 72:26). and he said: {say: none in the heavens or the earth knows the unseen except god} (sūrat al-naml 27:65). the prophet, may god bless him and grant him peace, made clear that the keys of the unseen — which are the locks of the unseen — are five, which none knows but god. and god, exalted, says: {and with him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them but he} (sūrat al-anʿām 6:59). and these five are: {indeed, god — with him is knowledge of the hour; and he sends down the rain; and he knows what is in the wombs. and no soul knows what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die} (sūrat luqmān 31:34).

attempting to look into them — as when a person wants to know his appointed term, or his provision and what he will be provided with tomorrow, or the time the rain will fall, or the coming of one who is absent, or the like — this is among the grave sins. its perpetrator may well be struck with trials; we ask god for safety and well-being. very often the one who seeks to look into that becomes exposed to trials, so that the jinn are set upon him and he is tried in his religion. trial in one's religion is the worst of afflictions; the worst of calamities is calamity in religion. the one who is tried in his religion has some truth appear to him in what the jinn tell him, or in what he comes to know by these means, and so he is put to trial by it and supposes that everything he is told from that quarter is true; and so he follows that dark path, and by it a foot slips after being firm, and he strays from the evenness of the way — we ask god for safety and well-being.

the believer is obliged to submit to god's decree, its good and its evil, and to believe in that; and to know that what has befallen him could not have missed him and what has missed him could not have befallen him; and that the pens have been lifted and the pages have dried over what is to be; and that nothing occurs in the universe except by god's command and his ordering. then he is content with everything that has been written for him, and is not one who reaches after what has been veiled from him. the more firmly bound a person is to god, and the stronger his faith in him, the less he cares to search out things of the unseen and matters he is not given to know.

i know a great old scholar, shaykh muhammad yabra ould bayyah, god's mercy be upon him, who was deaf and could not hear; whoever spoke with him would write for him in the air, and he would understand by the writing. i wrote to him that there is a device placed on the ear by means of which hearing is possible, and that i was ready to provide it for him. he said: i do not wish to come to know what my lord has kept from me. he never consented to use this device, even though it is among the permissible things and is not a matter of seeking to look into things of the unseen; but among the scholars there are those who reach a level of reliance upon god, glorified and exalted, at which they hold this kind of treatment to be like cauterisation — and the prophet, may god bless him and grant him peace, said: 'i do not like to be c
r: حكم امر المراه بالمعروف ونهيها عن المنكر هل يجوز امر المراه بالمعروف ونهيها عن المنكر؟ نعم، بل يجب عليها ان تامر بالمعروف وتنهي عن المنكر، ويجب كذلك امرها هي يجب علي الرجال اذا راوا من النساء منكرا ان ينهوا عن المنكر وان يامروا بالمعروف، وقد كان رسول الله (ص) يباشر ذلك، ففي الصحيحين انه خطب خطبه العيد فظن انه لم يسمع النساء فتوكا علي بلال فوقف علي النساء ووعظهن وقال يا معشر النساء تصدقن فاني رايتكن اكثر اهل النار، فبكي النساء فالقي بلال ثوبه فجعل النساء يهوين بايديهن الي حليهن ويرمينه في ثوب بلال. --------------------------------------------------------- حكم بعض الاذكار غير الوارده عن ياذن به الله ولم يات به رسول الله (ص) فلذلك لا بد من هجرانه وتركه وفيما جاء به رسول الله (ص) غنيه عن مثل هذا... ------------------------------------------------------------- حكم تعليق التماءم هل معلق ------------------------------------------------------------- حكم لكزانه ما حكم ما يسمي بالكزانه ايا كان نوعها؟ ان الغيب قد استاثر الله به، وقال: ﴿عالم الغيب فلا يظهر علي غيبه احدا﴾، وقال: ﴿قل لا يعلم من في السماوات ومن في الارض الغيب الا الله﴾، وقد بين النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم ان مفاتيح الغيب وهي مقاليد الغيب خمس لا يعلمهن الا الله، والله تعالي يقول: ﴿وعنده مفاتح الغيب لا يعلمها الا هو﴾، وهذه الخمس: ﴿ان الله عنده علم الساعه وينزل الغيث ويعلم ما في الارحام، وما تدري نفس ماذا تكسب غدا وما تدري نفس باي ارض تموت﴾، ومحاوله التطلع عليها كان يريد الانسان الاطلاع علي اجله او علي رزقه وما يرزق غدا، او علي وقت نزول المطر او مجيء الغاءب او نحو ذلك فهذا من الكباءر، وصاحبه ربما اصيب بالفتن نسال الله السلامه والعافيه، كثيرا ما يكون المتطلع الي ذلك عرضه للفتن فيسلط عليه الجن، ويفتن في دينه، والفتنه في الدين هي شر البلاء، شر البليه البلاء في الدين، والذي يبتلي في دينه يظهر له بعض الصدق فيما يخبر به الجان، او ما يطلع عليه عن طريق هذه الوساءل، فيفتن بذلك ويظن ان كل ما يخبر به عن هذا الوجه صدق، فيتبع ذلك السبيل المظلم وبذلك تزل قدم بعد ثبوتها ويضل عن سواء الصراط نسال الله السلامه والعافيه. يجب علي المءمن ان يستسلم لقدر الله خيره وشره، وان يءمن بذلك، وان يعلم ان ما اصابه لم يكن ليخطءه وان ما اخطاه لم يكن ليصيبه، وانه رفعت الاقلام وجفت الصحف عما هو كاءن، وانه لا يقع في الكون شيء الا بامر الله وتدبيره، فيرضي حينءذ بكل ما كتب له، ولا يكون حينءذ صاحب تطلع الي ما حجب عنه، وكلما كان الانسان اوثق صله بالله واقوي ايمانا به كلما زهد في البحث عن المغيبات والامور التي لا يطلع عليها. واعرف شيخا كبيرا من العلماء وهو الشيخ محمد يبر ولد بيه رحمه الله عليه كان اصم لا يسمع، وانما يكتب له محدثه في الهواء فيفقه بالكتابه، فكتبت له: ان جهازا يوضع علي الاذن يمكن عن طريقه السمع، واني مستعد لان اوفره له، فقال: انا لا اريد ان اطلع علي ما كتم ربي عني، فلم يرض ابدا باستعمال هذا الجهاز مع انه من الامور الجاءزه، وليس من التطلع علي الغيبيات، لكن من اهل العلم من يبلغ مستوي من التوكل علي الله سبحانه وتعالي يظن ان هذا النوع من المعالجه هو مثل الكي، والنبي صلي الله عليه وسلم قال: «ما احب ان اكتوي»، فيصل الي هذا المستوي، ولذلك فالكزانه اذا كانت هي الخط، فقد كان نبي من انبياء الله في الماضي يخط، فمن وافق خطه خط ذلك النبي فلا باس، والا فلا خير فيها، كما بين النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم ذلك، ونحن الان لا نستطيع ابدا ان نجزم بان اي شيء منها موافق لما كان ذلك النبي يخطه، لانه لا اسناد لنا في ذلك، فدل ذلك علي حرمه الاشتغال بها مطلقا بجميع انواعها وجميع هيءاتها، وانه لا يحل التطلع علي الغيبيات مطلقا باي وسيله من الوساءل.

t: The Expression 'I Guarantee upon God'
a: عباره اضمن علي الله
b:
people have grown accustomed to saying, 'i guarantee upon god that you will have such-and-such.' is this expression acceptable in the revealed law?

this expression rests, in origin, upon a fabricated hadith (mawḍūʿ), in which it comes: 'the miser is the one who does not guarantee upon god.' but this is not sound from the prophet, upon whom be peace; it is among the fabrications. for that reason a person should not say it — unless what he means by it is that the one who does the deed, if he does it seeking god's good pleasure, has been promised good by god for that deed. that is the intention that would make it acceptable; for you are able to guarantee what god has guaranteed in his book. everything that god has undertaken in his book, or that his messenger, upon whom be peace, has undertaken, you know will come to pass — so you can guarantee that it will occur.
r: ان الناس الفوا ان يقولوا اضمن علي الله لك كذا، فهل هذه العباره مستساغه شرعا؟ ان هذه العباره مبناها في الاصل علي حديث موضوع وقد جاء فيه: «البخيل من لا يضمن علي الله» لكن هذا لا يصح عن النبي (ص)، وهو من الموضوعات، فلذلك لا ينبغي ان يقولها الانسان الا اذا كان المقصود عنده ان صاحب الفعل ان فعل ذلك ابتغاء مرضاه الله فقد وعده الله خيرا علي ذلك الفعل، فهذا القصد، فانك تستطيع ضمان ما ضمنه الله في كتابه، كل ما تعهد الله به في كتابه او تعهد به رسوله (ص) فانت تعلم انه سيقع فيمكن ان تضمن وقوعه.

t: The Relation of the Science of Logic to the Affirmation of God's Oneness
a: علاقه علم المنطق بالتوحيد
b:
what is the relation of the science of logic to the affirmation of god's oneness (tawḥīd)?

the science of logic is the science of the rational measures by which a person grasps rational proofs. logic comes back to the distinction between conception (taṣawwur) and assent (taṣdīq). conception is the grasp of single terms; assent is the grasp of the relations between them. conception is arrived at only by way of definitions (muʿarrifāt), and assent only by way of proofs (ḥujaj). when a person knows these matters, he knows what counts as a proof rationally, what stands in need of demonstration and what does not; and he knows where error enters into proofs, and how proofs are put together. so it is an instrument of measurement in which there is nothing objectionable in the revealed law, neither in tawḥīd nor in anything else — but it can be turned to good use and it can be turned to evil use. learning it is like learning mathematics, like learning arithmetic, like learning writing: it is one of those measures with which clarified butter may be measured out, and wine may be measured out, and milk may be measured out. it goes according to the use that is made of it.
r: ما علاقه علم المنطق بالتوحيد؟ ان علم المنطق هو علم المقاييس العقليه التي يدرك بها الانسان الادله العقليه، فمرجع المنطق الي التفريق بين التصور والتصديق، والتصور هو ادراك المفردات والتصديق هو ادراك النسب، والتصور انما يوصل اليه بالمعرفات والتصديق انما يوصل اليه بالحجج، وهذه الامور اذا عرفها الانسان عرف ما هو دليل عقلا وما يحتاج الي الاثبات وما لا يحتاج اليه وعرف الخطا في الادله وطريقه تركيب الادله، فهو معيار ليس فيه محذور شرعا في التوحيد ولا في غيره، لكن يمكن ان يستغل في الخير ويمكن ان يستغل في الشر، فتعلمه مثل تعلم الرياضيات مثل تعلم الحساب مثل تعلم الكتابه هو من المعايير التي يمكن ان يكال بها السمن ويكال بها الخمر ويكال بها اللبن، فبحسب استغلاله.

t: Love of the Messenger of God, Peace and Blessings Be upon Him, and Love of What He Brought
a: محبه رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم ومحبه ما جاء به
b:
by what means does a person come to love the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, with a complete love, and to love everything he brought?

whoever wishes to love the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, must first come to know him — to know who the messenger of god is. if a person studies his biography (sīrah), his character and his life, he cannot but come to love him intensely. that is why, when qadi ʿiyad, god have mercy on him, composed the book al-shifāʾ fī l-taʿrīf bi-ḥuqūq al-muṣṭafā ('the cure: on making known the rights of the chosen one'), the people of andalusia read it and said: 'were it not for al-shifāʾ, the chosen one would not be known.' so a person must come to know the prophet, and must study his biography, his life and his personal qualities (shamāʾil), until he loves him intensely. then after that he should accustom himself to this love, knowing that it is a condition (sharṭ) of his faith (īmān), as the prophet said: 'none of you believes until i am more beloved to him than his father, his child and all people.' so he must train himself in loving him, in giving him preference, and in putting him ahead of everyone besides him.
r: باي طريقه يحب الانسان رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم محبه كامله ويحب كل ما جاء به؟ ان من اراد ان يحب رسول الله (ص) فعليه ان يتعرف عليه اولا، ان يعرف من هو رسول الله (ص)، فاذا درس الانسان سيرته وشخصيته وحياته فلا بد ان يحبه حبا شديدا، ولذلك فان اهل الاندلس لما الف القاضي عياض رحمه الله كتاب الشفا في التعريف بحقوق المصطفي (ص) فقراوه قالوا: لولا الشفا لما عرف المصطفي (ص)، فلا بد ان يتعرف الانسان الي النبي (ص) وان يدرس سيرته، وحياته وشماءله حتي يحبه حبا شديدا، ثم بعد ذلك ان يتعود علي هذه المحبه لعلمه انها شرط لايمانه كما قال النبي (ص): «لا يءمن احدكم حتي اكون احب اليه من والده وولده والناس اجمعين» فلا بد ان يتدرب علي محبته وايثاره وتقديمه علي كل من سواه.

t: May Whatever Could Be a Miracle for a Prophet Also Be a Wonder for a Friend of God?
a: هل ما جاز ان يكون معجزه لنبي جاز ان يكون كرامه لولي؟
b:
no. that cannot occur under any circumstance. if it were so, it would be possible for revelation to come down upon friends of god (awliyāʾ) who are not prophets — for the miracle of the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, is the revelation sent down to him. if everything that could be a miracle for a prophet could be a wonder (karāmah) for a friend of god, then many people would claim that a qur'an to be recited had been sent down to them; and this cannot occur at all, and no believer can conceive of it.

but the point of inquiry in the question is how far the wonders of the friends of god extend. the wonders of the friends of god are real, and affirming them is part of the creed of the people of the sunnah and the community: namely that god honours those who obey him. for god is the most generous of the generous and the most merciful of the merciful, and it is not possible that the people of faith and the people of unbelief should be equal in his sight — he who says in his book: {shall we then treat those who submit like the criminals? what is the matter with you? how do you judge?} (sūrat al-qalam 68:35–36).

so one who is of the people of god-consciousness, scrupulousness, worship and uprightness cannot ever be the equal of the open transgressor; they cannot be equal in the sight of god, exalted. for that reason he honours his friends with what helps them to obey him, and ennobles them with kinds of ennoblement, among which are beneficial knowledge and righteous action. the greatest of these wonders is steadfastness upon the religion: the greatest wonder with which god honours a friend of his is his steadfastness in the matter of religion, such that he has mastery over his own limbs where god has made something forbidden to him. the wonders are real, but there is disagreement over their extent — how far they reach. they agreed that they do not reach the descent of revelation, nor the coming to be of a child without a father, nor the raising of the dead; but they do reach what is below that, such as knowledge without learning, and help towards obedience, such as the folding up of distances, and the appearing of money without any means being taken to it, and the like. this does occur.

ʿumar ibn al-khattab, god be pleased with him, had his voice folded across a vast distance between medina and persia, when he called out to sariyah ibn zunaym and said: 'sariyah, the mountain! the mountain!' this report was brought out by ahmad in faḍāʾil al-ṣaḥābah by several chains of transmission, one of them a sound chain; and ibn wahb brought it out in al-jāmiʿ, and a number of authors in the collections of hadith; and it is a sound report. likewise ʿuthman, god be pleased with him, used to see the trace of a sin on the face of the one who had committed it. anas ibn malik was with him, and a man came in upon him, and he said: 'what is the matter with one of you, that he comes in upon me with the trace of fornication in his eyes?' and the man confessed. so anas said to him: 'is there revelation after the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him?' he said: 'no — but it is the discernment of the believer.'

it is the same in the case of a number of the companions of the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him: great wonders occurred for them. al-ʿala ibn al-hadrami, god be pleased with him, waded into the sea and it dried before him until he crossed it. and likewise the emigrant woman, for whom a bucket was let down from heaven so that she drank from it, when her own people left her thirsty. likewise those below them among the successors — much of this occurred for them too. indeed the shaykh al-islam ibn taymiyyah, god have mercy on him, said that the more faith and worship are diminished among people, and the more knowledge is diminished, the more the wonders increase — because when people are people of faith and scrupulousness and god-consciousness, they have no need of these wonders that increase their faith in the unseen; and when their faith in the unseen is diminished, these wonders become frequent among them, for the friends of god who are the people of steadfastness and of holding fast to the truth. and even so, many people confuse a wonder with what is no wonder at all.
r: لا ولا يمكن ان يقع ذلك بحال من الاحوال لو كان كذلك لجاز ان ينزل الوحي علي الاولياء الذين ليسوا بانبياء فمعجزه النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم الوحي المنزل اليه فلو كان كلما جاز ان يكون معجزه لنبي يجوز ان يكون كرامه لولي لادعي كثير من الناس انهم انزل اليهم قرءان يتلي وهذا لا يمكن ان يقع اصلا و لا يمكن ان يتصوره مءمن لكن البحث في المساله هو ما تصل اليه كرامات الاولياء فكرامات الاولياء حق ومن عقيده اهل السنه والجماعه اثباتها وهي ان الله يكرم من اطاعه فالله اكرم الاكرمين وارحم الراحمين ولا يمكن ان يتساوي لديه اهل الايمان واهل الكفر وهو الذي يقول في كتابه﴿افنجعل المسلمين كالمجرمين ما لكم كيف تحكمون﴾ فمن كان من اهل التقوي والورع و العباده والصلاح لا يمكن ان يستوي مع الفاسق المجاهر ابدا لا يمكن ان يستويا عند الله تعالي فلذلك يكرم اولياءه بما يعينهم عليه من طاعته و يشرفهم بانواع التشريف الذي منه العلم النافع والعمل الصالح وهذه الكرامات اعظمها الاستقامه علي الدين اعظم كرامه يكرم الله بها الولي استقامته علي امر الدين بحيث يملك جوارحه عما حرم الله عليه والكرامات حق لكن اختلف في مبلغها الي اي شيء تبلغ واتفقوا علي انها لا تبلغ نزول الوحي او وجود ولد من غير والد او احياء الموتي لكنها تبلغ ما دون ذلك كالعلم من غير تعلم وكالعون علي الطاعه كطي المسافات ووجود الاموال من غير تسبب ونحو ذلك فهذا حاصل فعمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه طوي صوته مسافه شاسعه ما بين المدينه و بين فارس حين نادي ساريه ابن زنيم فقال يا ساريه الجبل الجبل وهذا الحديث اخرجه احمد في فضاءل الصحابه بعده اسانيد احدها اسناد صحيح وقد اخرجه ابن وهب في الجامع و عدد من المءلفين في دواوين الحديث وهو حديث صحيح وكذلك فان عثمان رضي الله عنه كان يري اثر المعصيه في وجه صاحبها فقد كان عنده انس ابن مالك فدخل عليه رجل فقال: ما بال احدكم يدخل علي وفي عينيه اثر الزنا فاقر الرجل فقال له انس اوحي بعد رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم قال لا ولكنها فراسه المءمن وكذلك الحال بالنسبه لعدد من اصحاب رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم حصلت لهم كرامات عظيمه فالعلاء ابن الحضرمي رضي الله عنه خاض البحر فيبس امامه حتي قطعه وكذلك فان المراه المهاجره تدلي لها دلو من السماء حتي شربت منه حين ظماها اهلها، وكذلك فان من دونهم من التابعين حصل لهم ايضا شيء كثير من هذا بل قد قال شيخ الاسلام ابن تيميه رحمه الله ان الكرامات كلما انتقص الايمان والعباده في الناس وكلما انتقص العلم كلما ازدادت هي لان الناس اذا كانوا اهل ايمان و ورع وتقوي لا يحتاجون الي هذه الكرامات التي تزيد ايمانهم بالغيب واذا نقص لديهم الايمان بالغيب كثرت فيهم هذه الكرامات لاولياء الله اصحاب الاستقامه و الالتزام بالحق ومع هذا فان كثيرا من الناس تلتبس عليهم الكرامه بما ليس بكرامه.

t: Is This the Time of al-Khuwayṣṣah?
a: هل هذا زمان الخويصه ؟
b:
no. the time of al-khuwayṣṣah is the time in which a person is not obeyed when he commands: when he forbids a wrong he is not obeyed, and when he enjoins a right he is not obeyed. in this time of ours people still — praise be to god — have much good in them, so that time has not yet come. nor is that time continuous for a long period, as some people imagine: they suppose that the time of al-khuwayṣṣah is the end of this community, or a continuous stretch of it, and this is not correct. the time of al-khuwayṣṣah is a period that passes over towns when god wills to destroy them; for god, exalted, has undertaken the destruction of every town before the coming of the hour, saying, exalted: {and there is no town but that we shall destroy it before the day of resurrection, or punish it with a severe punishment; that is written in the book} (sūrat al-isrāʾ 17:58).

and god has set out the sign of that destruction: that he gives power over the town to the luxurious among its people, so that they command in it and multiply corruption in it, and no one is able to change what they do or to denounce them — because they make people afraid, so that everyone submits to them and praises them to their faces and blames them behind their backs, and denounces nothing of what they do. so when that appears, and there is no one to denounce the wrong, that is the time of al-khuwayṣṣah: the people of good withdraw, until the punishment comes and destroys that town. that is why god, exalted, said: {and when we will to destroy a town, we command its luxurious ones} (sūrat al-isrāʾ 17:16) — 'we command' meaning we made them commanders, which is why in the other canonical reading it is {we appointed as commanders}; {so they transgress in it, and the word comes due against it, and we destroy it utterly}. these things follow closely on one another, because the connective fa indicates sequence and immediate succession, so when the linkage comes with fa it implies closeness: {we command its luxurious ones, so they transgress in it, so the word comes due against it, so we destroy it utterly}. they are matters very different from one another. these things — their time is the time of al-khuwayṣṣah, if that happens.

but this community is still in a good state, and there are in it many of the people of steadfastness and uprightness, and many who love good and love its people. so let no one be deluded into thinking that withdrawal is better in this time of ours; that is not correct. the believer who mixes with people and bears their harm patiently is better than the believer who does not mix with people and does not bear their harm patiently.
r: لا فزمان الخويصه هو الزمان الذي لا يطاع فيه الانسان اذا امر، اذا نهي عن منكر لم يطع و اذا امر بمعروف لم يطع و هذا الزمان ما زال الناس و لله الحمد فيهم خير كثير فلم يات ذلك الزمان بعد و ذلك الزمان لا يكون ايضا مستمرا لوقت طويل كما يتوهمه بعض الناس يظن ان زمان الخويصه هو اخر هذه الامه او زمان مستمر منها وهذا غير صحيح زمان الخويصه فتره تمر بالقري اذا اراد الله اهلاكها فان الله تعالي تعهد باهلاك كل قريه قبل قيام الساعه فقال تعالي:﴿و ان من قريه الا نحن مهلكوها قبل يوم القيامه او معذبوها عذابا شديدا كان ذلك في الكتاب مسطورا﴾ و قد بين الله علامه ذلك الاهلاك و هو ان يسلط عليها مترفي اهلها فيامرهم فيها فيكثروا فيها الفساد فلا يستطيع احد التغيير عليهم و لا الانكار عليهم لانهم يخوفون الناس فيستسلم لهم الجميع فيمدحونهم في وجوههم و يذمونهم في قفاهم و لا ينكرون عليهم شيءا مما يفعلونه فاذا ظهر ذلك و لم يوجد منكر للمنكر فذلك وقت الخويصه يعتزل اهل الخير حتي ياتي العذاب فيهلك تلك القريه و لذلك قال الله تعالي: ﴿و اذا اردنا ان نهلك قريه امرنا مترفيها﴾، امرنا بمعني جعلناهم امراء و لذلك في القراءه الاخري ﴿امرنا﴾ ﴿ففسقوا فيها فحق عليها القول فدمرناها تدميرا﴾ وهذه الامور متقاربه لان الفاء للترتيب و التعقيب فاذا جاء العطف بالفاء فانه يقتضي القرب: ﴿امرنا مترفيها ففسقوا فيها فحق عليها القول فدمرناها تدميرا﴾ امور متفاوته جدا و هذه الامور وقتها هو وقت الخويصه اذا حصل ذلك لكن هذه الامه ما زالت بخير و فيها كثير من اهل الاستقامه و الصلاح وفيها كثير من الذين يحبون الخير و يحبون اهله و لذلك لا يغتر احد بان العزله افضل في هذا الزمان فهذا غير صحيح فالمءمن الذي يخالط الناس ويصبر علي اذاهم خير من المءمن الذي لا يخالط الناس و لا يصبر علي اذاهم.

t: The Means of Strengthening Faith
a: وساءل تقويه الايمان
b:
what is the best way to develop faith?

there is no doubt that faith increases through righteous deeds and through the means that lead to god, glorified and exalted. in some deeds their increasing of faith can be observed — such as the voluntary prayers, and especially standing in prayer at night: prayer in the night while people are asleep. and likewise hidden acts of charity; and likewise pondering the qur'an; and likewise admonition, with a person alone, until his tears flow; and likewise visiting graves, and visiting the sick, and beholding the wonders of god's creation; and likewise pondering the signs of this vast, wondrous, governed universe. all of this is among the things that increase faith in god, glorified and exalted, and increase love of him and reliance upon him.

and among the most effective of that is avoiding acts of disobedience, for it is these acts of disobedience that sap faith and weaken it. when a person falls into an act of disobedience, his faith is diminished by the measure of that act: if it was a small one, his faith is diminished by a small amount; and if it was a great one, his faith is diminished by a great amount, and so on. so let a person safeguard his faith first by avoiding acts of disobedience, and then let him increase it and adorn it by increasing righteous deeds, as far as he is able to find a way to it. the best of that is the obligatory acts, and then what is added to them of voluntary acts — as is soundly established in the noble divine report, in which the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, said, relating from his lord, mighty and majestic: 'my servant draws near to me with nothing more beloved to me than what i have made obligatory upon him. and my servant continues to draw near to me with voluntary acts until i love him; and when i love him i am his hearing with which he hears, and his sight with which he sees, and his hand with which he grasps, and his foot with which he walks. and if he asks me, i shall surely give him; and if he seeks refuge with me, i shall surely grant him refuge.'

and there is no doubt that among the things that diminish faith is occupying oneself with the adornments of this world and turning towards it, for this world is a distraction from the hereafter; whereas the hereafter — pondering it, and reflecting on it, and remembering the destroyer of pleasures, which is death — is among the things that increase faith. but to be immersed in preoccupation with the world's pleasures and its appetites, and in looking at what its people have, is among the things that diminish faith. that is why god, exalted, said to his messenger, peace and blessings be upon him: {and do not strain your eyes towards what we have given certain groups of them to enjoy, the splendour of the life of this world, that we may try them thereby; and the provision of your lord is better and more lasting. and command your family to pray, and be steadfast in it. we ask no provision of you; it is we who provide for you. and the final outcome belongs to god-consciousness} (sūrat ṭā hā 20:131–132). so a person should look less at what he has not been given of this world, and should look, in worldly matters, to one who is below him, and look, in religion, to one who is above him — for that is more fitting to keep him from making light of god's favour upon him, as the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, directed.
r: ما هي افضل طريقه لتنميه الايمان؟ لا شك ان الايمان يزداد بالاعمال الصالحه وبالوساءل الي الله سبحانه وتعالي فبعض الاعمال تشاهد زيادتها للايمان، وذلك مثل نوافل الصلوات وبالاخص قيام الليل، فصلاه الليل والناس نيام، وكذلك الصدقات الخفيه وكذلك تدبر القران وكذلك الموعظه والانسان خال حتي تسيل دمعتاه، وكذلك زياره القبور وعياده المرضي ومشاهده عجاءب خلق الله، وكذلك التدبر في ايات هذا الكون الفسيح العجيب المدبر، كل هذا مما يزيد الايمان بالله سبحانه وتعالي ويزيد محبته والتوكل عليه، وان من ابلغ ذلك اجتناب المعاصي، فهذه المعاصي هي التي توهن الايمان وتضعفه، واذا وقع الشخص في معصيه انتقص من ايمانه قدر تلك المعصيه، اذا كانت صغيره انتقص من ايمانه صغير واذا كانت كبيره انتقص من ايمانه كبير وهكذا، فليحافظ الانسان علي ايمانه باجتناب المعاصي اولا، ثم يزيده ويحليه بزياده الاعمال الصالحه ما استطاع الي ذلك سبيلا، وافضل ذلك الفراءض ثم ما تزاد به من النوافل كما صح في الحديث القدسي الشريف ان رسول الله (ص) قال فيما يرويه عن ربه عز وجل: «وما تقرب الي عبدي بشيء احب الي مما افترضته عليه، ولا يزال عبدي يتقرب الي بالنوافل حتي احبه، فاذا احببته كنت سمعه الذي يسمع به وبصره الذي يبصر به ويده التي يبطش بها ورجله التي يمشي بها، ولءن سالني لاعطينه ولءن استعاذ بي لاعيذنه، ولا شك ان مما ينقص الايمان الاشتغال بزخارف هذه الدنيا والاقبال عليها، فهذه الدنيا ملهاه عن الاخره، والاخره التدبر فيها والتفكر فيها وتذكر هاذم اللذات الذي هو الموت مما يزيد الايمان، اما الاغراق في الانشغال بملذات الدنيا وشهواتها والنظر الي ما فيه اهلها فهو مما ينقص الايمان ولهذا قال الله تعالي لرسوله (ص): {ولا تمدن عينيك الي ما متعنا به ازواجا منهم زهره الحياه الدنيا لنفتنهم فيه ورزق ربك خير وابقي (131) وامر اهلك بالصلاه واصطبر عليها لا نسالك رزقا نحن نرزقك والعاقبه للتقوي (132)} [طه] فعلي الانسان ان يتقلل من النظر الي ما لم يعطه من هذه الدنيا، وان ينظر في الدنيا الي من هو دونه، وان ينظر في الدين الي من هو فوقه فان ذلك اجدر به ان لا يزدري نعمه الله عليه، كما ارشد الي ذلك رسول الله (ص).

t: Fasting the Day of ʿArafah Where the Moonrises Differ
a: صيام يوم عرفه باختلاف المطالع
b:
i am a student in malaysia, and the day of ʿarafah with us falls on the sixteenth of november, while the pilgrims will stand at ʿarafah on the fifteenth of november. how am i to fast the day of ʿarafah? that is, the day on which the pilgrims stand, which in malaysia coincides with the eid?

the answer is that he fasts the ninth day of dhu al-hijjah according to the reckoning of the homeland he is in and the country he is in. that is because the people of each country, when the moonrises differ and the timing differs, have their own time. just as it is not permissible for him to pray according to the prayer of the people of mecca, so likewise he does not fast according to their fasting. for the day, with the people of mecca, begins at midday — or at the end of the day — for the people of malaysia. therefore the day of ʿarafah in his case is not the day on which the pilgrims stand; rather it is the ninth day of dhu al-hijjah.
r: انا طالب في ماليزيا ويوم عرفه عندنا يوافق يوم السادس عشر من نوفمبر بينما الحجاج سوف يقفون بعرفه يوم الخامس عشر من نوفمبر، كيف اصوم يوم عرفه ؟ اي اليوم الذي يقف فيه الحجاج وهو يوافق في ماليزيا العيد ؟ الجواب انه يصوم اليوم التاسع من ذي الحجه علي مقتضي الوطن الذي هو فيه والبلد الذي هو فيه وذلك ان اهل كل بلد عندما تختلف المطالع ويختلف التوقيت، لهم وقتهم كما انه لا يجوز له ان يصلي بصلاه اهل مكه فكذلك لا يصوم بصيامهم، فاليوم عند اهل مكه يبدا بوسط النهار او اخره عند اهل ماليزيا لذلك فيوم عرفه في حقه هو ليس هو اليوم الذي يقف فيه الحجاج بل هو اليوم التاسع من ذي الحجه.

t: The Ruling on What Is Called 'l-ḥjāb', and on the Use of the Grids and the Magic Squares
a: حكم ما يسمي ب " لحجاب" واستعمال الجداول والاوفاق
b:
i ask you to clarify the ruling of the revealed law on what is called among us 'l-ḥjāb', and whether it is permissible to use the awfāq, or what are called the jadāwil??

the answer is that 'l-ḥjāb' is applied to certain incantations and amulets and the like. it is a general name covering both the sound and the defective. some of it is sound, such as the lawful incantation (ruqyah) by the qur'an and by sound hadith; and some of it is void, such as what belongs to sorcery, and — among the sciences of evil — the science of the grid. the science of the grids and of the magic squares (al-awfāq) is entirely among the sciences of evil, so it is not lawful for a muslim to occupy himself with it, nor to hang it about himself.

the people of knowledge differed concerning that by which sorcery is undone. some of them held it permissible, because it is beneficial and not harmful, and because god, exalted, says: 'and they learn what harms them and does not benefit them' — this being the distinguishing property of sorcery, that it harms and does not benefit, whereas what benefits and does not harm does not fall under its definition. but the position of the majority is that this is not lawful at all, and that the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, invalidated it by his words: 'whoever introduces into this affair of ours something that is not of it, it is rejected' — and in a transmission of muslim's: 'whoever performs an act that our affair is not in accordance with, it is rejected.'

so this is not among what the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, brought from god. therefore the muslim does not occupy himself with it, and it is not lawful for him to undertake it.
r: اطلب منكم توضيح الحكم الشرعي لما يسمي عندنا ب "لحجاب"، وهل يجوز استعمال الاوفاق او ما يسمي بالجداول ؟؟. الجواب ان لحجاب يطلق علي بعض الرقي والتماءم ونحوها وهو اسم عام يشمل الصحيح والفاسد ففيه ما هو صحيح مثل الرقيا بالقران والحديث الصحيح، وفيه ما هو باطل مثل ما كان من السحر ومن علوم الشر علم الجدول فعلم الجداول والاوفاق كله من علوم الشر فلا يحل للمسلم الاشتغال به ولا تعليقه، واختلف اهل العلم فيما يحل السحر منه فقد ذهب بعضهم الي جوازه لانه نافع غير ضار ولان الله تعالي يقول " فيتعلمون ما يضرهم ولا ينفعهم " فهذه خاصيه السحر فهو يضر ولا ينفع، اما ما ينفع ولا يضر فهو ليس داخلا في تعريفه ولكن مذهب الجمهور ان ذلك لا يحل مطلقا وان النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم ابطله بقوله: " من احدث في امرنا هذا ما ليس منه فهو رد"، وفي روايه لمسلم من عمل عملا ليس عليه امرنا فهو رد". فهذا ليس مما جاء به رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم من عند لله فلذلك لا يشتغل به المسلم ولا يحل له الاقدام عليه.

t: The Supplications of the Funeral Prayer
a: ادعيه صلاه الجنازه
b:
what is the supplication that is established in the prayer over the dead, and what is the soundness of the supplication called the supplication of abu hurayra, god be pleased with him?

many reports have come down concerning supplication in the funeral prayer. the supplication he asked about — the one ascribed to abu hurayra, god be pleased with him — is a report stopping at a companion (mawqūf): it is established from abu hurayra, but he did not trace it back to the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. as for the reports traced to the prophet (marfūʿ), among them are his words, peace and blessings be upon him: 'o god, forgive our living and our dead, our present and our absent, our elder and our younger, our male and our female. you know our comings and goings and our resting place. o god, whomever of us you keep alive, keep him alive upon islam; and whomever of us you cause to die, cause him to die upon faith. o god, forgive this dead person and have mercy on him, and grant him well-being and pardon him, and shelter him from the trial of the grave and from the punishment of the grave and from the punishment of the fire. o god, if he was a doer of good, then increase him in his good; and if he was a wrongdoer, then overlook his misdeeds. o god, do not deprive us of his reward and do not put us to trial after him, and forgive us and forgive him.' and there are others besides that among the reports carrying this same sense: 'o god, our companion has alighted with you, and you are the most generous with whom any guest alights. o god, so make his lodging generous, and widen his place of entry, and give him in exchange a home better than his home, and a family better than his family, and a spouse better than his spouse; and wash him with water and snow and hail, and cleanse him of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt.' and there are still others besides these among the reports.
r: ما الدعاء الثابت في الصلاه علي الميت وما صحه الدعاء الذي يسمي دعاء ابي هريره رضي الله عنه؟ ان الدعاء في صلاه الجناءز ورد فيه كثير من الاحاديث، والدعاء الذي سال عنه وهو الدعاء المنسوب الي ابي هريره رضي الله عنه موقوف، ثابت عن ابي هريره لكنه لم يرفعه الي النبي (ص)، اما الاحاديث المرفوعه عن النبي (ص) فمنها قوله (ص): (اللهم اغفر لحينا ولميتنا ولشاهدنا ولغاءبنا ولكبيرنا ولصغيرنا ولذكرنا ولانثانا انك تعلم متقلبنا ومثوانا، اللهم من احييته منها فاحيه علي الاسلام ومن امته منا فامته علي الايمان، اللهم اغفر لهذا الميت وارحمه وعافه واعف عنه واجره من فتنه القبر ومن عذاب القبر ومن عذاب النار، اللهم ان كان محسنا فزد في احسانه، وان كان مسيءا فتجاوز عنه سيءاته، اللهم لا تحرمنا اجره ولا تفتنا بعده واغفر لنا وله)، وغير ذلك من الاحاديث التي في معني هذا (اللهم ان صاحبنا قد نزل بك وانت اكرم منزول به، اللهم فاكرم نزله ووسع مدخله وابدله دارا خيرا من داره واهلا خيرا من اهله وزوجا خيرا من زوجه واغسله بالماء والثلج والبرد ونقه من الخطايا كما ينقي الثوب الابيض من الدنس)، الي غير ذلك من الاحاديث.

t: The Best Standing in Prayer at Night
a: افضل القيام
b:
what is the best standing in prayer at night?

the best standing at night is that in which a person feels the sweetness of standing at night — that which draws from him weeping, and awe, and humility, and pondering. this is the best standing at night. as for that of which a person tastes no savour, and which passes him by colourless, just so, having no effect upon him — this is not the standing that is called for.
r: ما افضل قيام الليل؟ ان افضل قيام الليل ما يحس به الانسان بلذه قيام الليل، ما اقتضي منه بكاء وخشيه وخشوعا وتدبرا هذا افضل قيام الليل، اما ما لا يذوق له الانسان طعما ويمر به باهتا هكذا لا تاثير له عليه فليس هذا بالقيام المطلوب.

t: The Means That Help with Standing in Prayer at Night
a: الوساءل المعينه علي قيام الليل
b:
what are the means that help with standing in prayer at night?

among them, first, that a person should grasp the worth of standing in prayer at night and its effect upon his faith; and that he should grasp that god, exalted, laughs at the one who stands in the depth of the night; and that he should grasp the effect of that upon himself — for whoever's work is good by night, his face is good by day. and likewise that he should grasp the difference between the state of the one who stands praying and speaking intimately with god, exalted, while people are asleep, and the state of the sleeper snoring on his bed: prayer is better than sleep. likewise he must seek help for standing at night by sleeping a part of the day, whatever part it may be — he sleeps a little of the day — or by sleeping at the beginning of the night: if he prays the night prayer and then sleeps, he is bound to wake in the middle of the night or at its end, which is the best part of it; for the night vigil (nāshiʾat al-layl) is what god commanded recitation in, saying: {truly the vigil of the night is stronger in tread and more upright in speech} (sūrat al-muzzammil 73:6).

likewise he ought to seek help in it with an instrument such as an alarm, whether on the telephone or on a clock, which alerts him and wakes him at that hour. and likewise he should seek help in it from his household. abu dawud brought out in the sunan that the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'god have mercy on a man who rises in the night to pray and wakes his wife so that she may pray with him — and if she sleeps on, he sprinkles water on her face. and god have mercy on a woman who rises in the night to pray and wakes her husband so that he may pray with her — or her spouse so that he may pray with her — and if he sleeps on, she sprinkles water on his face.' then likewise seeking help from the neighbours, and this is part of cooperating in righteousness and god-consciousness. if you keep up with your neighbour and there has come to be affection and familiarity between you, and you ask him to cooperate with you in standing at night, and to knock at your door at such and such an hour and keep you to it — this is among the things the companions of the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, used to do. salman would come to abu al-darda, and abu al-darda used to stand the whole night in prayer; so salman held him back and said: 'sleep now.' then when it was the middle of the night he said: 'rise now.' this is the kind of thing in which neighbours keep up with one another and each helps the other.
