the proceedings of the third conference of the kuala lumpur forum closed just after noon this saturday, 19 november 2016, corresponding to 19 safar 1438 ah, in the sudanese capital khartoum. the conference was entitled 'good governance: an islamic vision'.

his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan ould al-dedew, president of the centre for the formation of scholars, delivered an address at today's session in which he spoke about the sharia's vision of good governance, calling to mind luminous examples from the history of the islamic community.

the conference had opened two days earlier under the chairmanship of his excellency dr mahathir mohamad, president of the kuala lumpur forum and former prime minister of malaysia, with the participation of scholarly and intellectual figures of influence in the islamic arena.

those taking part in the conference addressed the most important and prominent difficulties of good governance, presenting a contemporary islamic vision of all the questions they discussed.
r: اختتم زوال اليوم السبت 19 نوفمبر 2016م الموافق 19 صفر 1438ه بالعاصمه السودانيه الخرطوم اعمال المءتمر الثالث لملتقي كوالالمبور و الذي كان بعنوان : " الحكم الراشد : رءيه اسلاميه . وقد القي فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رءيس مركز تكوين العلماء، كلمه في جلسه اليوم تحدث فيها عن الرءيه الشرعيه للحكم الراشد مستحضرا نماذج مشرقه من تاريخ الامه الاسلاميه. و كان المءتمر قد افتتح قبل يومين برءاسه فضيله الدكتور مهاتير محمد رءيس منتدي كوالالمبور و رءيس وزراء ماليزيا الاسبق و بمشاركه شخصيات علميه و فكريه مءثره في الساحه الاسلاميه. وقد تناول المشاركون في المءتمر اهم و ابرز اشكالات الحكم الرشيد مقدمين رءيه اسلاميه معاصره لكافه القضايا التي ناقشوها.

t: Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in a Ceremony Honouring Sheikh Ahmad al-Raysuni at Chouaib Doukkali University
a: الشيخ الددو يشارك في حفل تكريم الشيخ احمد الريسوني بجامعه شعيب الدكالي
b:
his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew al-shinqiti (may god the exalted preserve him) took part on tuesday 28 november 2017, as a principal guest, in the opening ceremony of a scholarly colloquium organised by the laboratory for islamic studies and community development at chouaib doukkali university in the moroccan city of el jadida, in honour of his eminence dr ahmad al-raysuni. he will offer a testimonial concerning the doctor, and it is expected that his eminence will deliver an address within the subject of the colloquium accompanying the ceremony: 'research in the higher objectives, between the authenticity of the method and the novelties of present reality'.

among the aims of the scholarly colloquium are to bring to light the varied functions of considering the higher objectives (maqāṣid), and to connect research in the higher objectives with the questions of the age and its varied, renewing and newly arising human concerns, in a way that serves the true interests of the human being and achieves the true development sought both by the sharia and by reason.
r: شارك فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو الشنقيطي حفظه الله تعالي يوم الثلاثاء 28 نوفمبر 2017م بوصفه ضيفا اساسيا في حفل افتتاح ندوه علميه ينظمها مختبر الدراسات الاسلاميه والتنميه المجتمعيه في جامعه شعيب الدكالي بمدينه الجديده المغربيه تكريما لفضيله الدكتور احمد الريسوني وسيقدم شهاده عن الدكتور ومن المتنظر ان يلقي فضيلته كلمه ضمن موضوع الندوه المصاحبه للحفل : البحث المقاصدي بين اصاله المنهج ومستجدات الواقع . ومن اهداف الندوه العلميه الكشف عن الوظاءف المتنوعه للنظر المقاصدي و ربط البحث المقاصدي باسءله العصر وقضاياه الانسانيه المتنوعه والمتجدده والمستحدثه بما يخدم المصالح الحقيقيه للانسان ويحقق التنميه الحقيقيه المنشوده شرعا وعقلا.

t: How Do We Guard against the Sin of Mixing in Schools, and What Governs Speech between Unrelated Men and Women? Do Joking and Ordinary Conversation Really Fall under It?
a: كيف نتقي معصيه الاختلاط في المدارس وما ضابط الكلام بين الاجانب ؟ هل يدخل فيه حقا المزاح والكلام العام
b:
the sin of mixing is guarded against by keeping the two sexes apart — "let them not take the middle of the roads, and let them circumambulate behind the men" — and by not crowding at the doorways — "and he would order the men not to leave until the women had left" — and by there being no private seclusion (khalwah) between a man and a woman unrelated to him — "no man is ever alone with a woman but that satan is the third of them" — and by there being no speech in which there is anything suspect, or speech in which pleasure is taken — {so do not be soft in speech, lest he in whose heart is a disease should covet} (sūrat al-aḥzāb 33:32).

as for speech other than that, there is no objection in it — {and speak a word that is fitting} (sūrat al-aḥzāb 33:32) — and that includes joking in matters that have nothing to do with what passes between men and women.
r: تتقي معصيه الاختلاط بالتباعد بين الجنسين ( لا يحققن الطرق و ليطفن من وراء الرجال ) و عدم التزاحم علي الابواب ( و يامر الرجال ان لا ينصرفوا حتي ينصرف النساء ) و عدم الخلوه بين رجل و اجنبيه ( ما خلا رجل بامراه الا كان الشيطان ثالثهما ) و عدم الكلام في الريبه او بما يلتذ به ( فلا تخضعن بالقول فيطمع الذي في قلبه مرض ) اما غير ذلك من الكلام فلا حرج فيه ( و قلن قولا معروفا ) و منه المزاح فيما لا علاقه له بما يكون بين الرجال و النساء

t: Is It Permissible for a Menstruating Woman to Recite Verses of the Qur'an to Open a Lecture or as an Exhortation?
a: هل قراءه ايات من القران استهلالا لمحاضره او تذكيرا يجوز للحاءض ؟
b: it is permissible for a menstruating woman to recite the qur'an from memory, at the opening of lessons and elsewhere, because the lifting of what bars her is not in her own hands — unlike the person in a state of major ritual impurity (junub).
r: يجوز للحاءض قراءه القران من حفظها في افتتاح الدروس و غيره لان رفع مانعها ليس بيدها بخلاف الجنب.

t: If the Qur'an Is Recited in Someone's Presence, Is He Obliged to Listen in Silence?
a: اذا قرء القران بحضره احد هل يلزمه الانصات له ؟
b: the exegetes are in consensus that the words of god, be he exalted, {and when the qur'an is recited, listen to it and be silent} (sūrat al-aʿrāf 7:204), mean its recitation in the prayer — that is, the imam's recitation. as for other than that, listening to it is not obligatory (wājib), but it is recommended (mandūb), and the listener has half the reward of the one reciting.
r: اجمع المفسرون علي ان قول الله تعالي ( و اذا قرء القران فاستمعوا له و انصتوا ) ان المقصود قراءته في الصلاه اي قراءه الامام. اما في غير ذلك فلا يجب الاستماع له لكنه مندوب و له نصف اجر القراءه

t: The Ruling on Men and Women Gathering under One Roof for a Particular Task
a: حكم اجتماع الرجال والنساء تحت سقف واحد لعمل معين
b:
peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings. our sheikh, one of the brothers asks about the ruling on men and women gathering under one roof for a particular task… and about the ruling on the customary practice of unrelated men entering houses in which there are unrelated women.

answer: and upon you be peace, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

in the prophetic era the houses were nothing but ḥujar — that is, single rooms — in which men and women gathered in every room; and it was for that reason that god laid down the seeking of permission at three hours. likewise the women used to pray together with the men in the mosque of the messenger of god (peace and blessings be upon him), and he would order the men not to leave until the women had left, and would order the women not to raise their heads from the prostration until the men had sat up, so that nothing of the men's nakedness should be exposed.

but this gathering has governing conditions. among them: that there be no private seclusion (khalwah) between an unrelated man and an unrelated woman at all; that the women cover what god has obliged them to cover; that they not wear perfume; and that there be no softness of speech, and no speech in which there is anything suspect. and god knows best.
r: السلام عليكم ورحمه الله وبركاته شيخنا احد الاخوه يسال عن حكم اجتماع الرجال والنساء تحت سقف واحد لعمل معين.. وعن حكم عاده دخول الاجانب منازل فيها اجنبيات الجواب و عليكم السلام و رحمه الله و بركاته لم تكن البيوت في العهد النبوي الا حجرا اي غرفا يجتمع الرجال و النساء في كل غرفه و قد شرع الله الاستءذان في ثلاث ساعات لذلك و كذلك كان النساء يصلين مع الرجال في مسجد رسول الله صلي الله عليه و سلم فكان يامر الرجال ان لا ينصرفوا حتي ينصرف النساء و يامر النساء ان لا يرفعن من السجود حتي يجلس الرجال لءلا ينكشف شيء من عورات الرجال لكن لهذا الاجتماع ضوابط منها عدم خلوه اجنبي باجنبيه مطلقا و ستر النساء ما اوجب الله عليهن ستره و عدم تطيبهن و عدم الخضوع بالقول و الكلام في الريبه و الله اعلم

t: Sheikh al-Dedew on a Fraternal Visit to Dr Anwar Ibrahim
a: الشيخ الددو في زياره اخويه للدكتور انور ابراهيم
b:
on the morning of monday 30 july 2018, his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew, president of the centre for the formation of scholars and president of abdullah ibn yasin university in mauritania (may god the exalted preserve him), paid a fraternal visit, and a sick visit, to dr anwar ibrahim, former deputy prime minister of malaysia and a member of the present governing coalition.

the visit was an occasion to make sure of the doctor's state of health after he had undergone an operation — a successful one, praise be to god — at one of the hospitals in the turkish capital istanbul; and it was likewise an opportunity to review the various questions of the islamic community and its concerns.

his eminence closed the visit by praying for dr anwar ibrahim's recovery, and for the islamic community: for victory, prosperity and establishment in the land.
r: ادي صباح اليوم الاثنين 30 يوليو 2018م فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رءيس مركز تكوين العلماء و رءيس جامعه عبد الله بن ياسين بموريتانيا – حفظه الله تعالي – زياره اخويه وعياده للدكتور انور ابراهيم ناءب رءيس الوزراء الماليزي السابق وعضو الاءتلاف الحكومي الحالي وكانت الزياره مناسبه للاطمءنان علي الحاله الصحيه للدكتور بعد ان اجري عمليه جراحيه - ناجحه و لله الحمد - في احد المستشفيات في العاصمه التركيه اسطنبول، و كما كانت فرصه لاستعراض مختلف قضايا الامه الاسلاميه وهمومها. وختم فضيله الشيخ الزياره بالدعاء للدكتور انور ابراهيم بالشفاء وللامه الاسلاميه بالنصر والرخاء والتمكين.

t: A Delegation of Members of the Kuala Lumpur Forum for Thought and Civilisation Meets the Malaysian Prime Minister Dr Mahathir Mohamad, Chairman of the Forum
a: وفد من اعضاء منتدي كوالالمبور للفكر و الحضاره يلتقون برءيس الوزراء الماليزي الدكتور مهاتير محمد رءيس المنتدي
b:
the president of the centre for the formation of scholars and rector of abdullah ibn yasin university in mauritania, sheikh muhammad al-hasan ibn al-dedew, accompanied by members of the kuala lumpur forum for thought and civilisation, met the malaysian prime minister, dr mahathir mohamad.

those meeting discussed various matters of concern to the muslim ummah, the most prominent of them matters relating to democracy and public freedoms, and some of the matters falling within the aims of the kuala lumpur forum for thought and civilisation, which is chaired by the malaysian prime minister dr mahathir mohamad and in which his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew holds the position of first deputy chairman.

the meeting took place in the turkish city of istanbul, where his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan ibn al-dedew resides.

those meeting also discussed with the malaysian [prime minister] ways of advancing and developing the forum in the days ahead.

the kuala lumpur forum is an international intellectual institution founded in 2014 in malaysia by a large number of scholars and intellectual and political figures in the arab and islamic world.

the forum concerns itself with the question of democracy and public freedoms, as well as mediation, reconciliation and the resolution of the crises of the muslim world.
r: التقي رءيس مركز تكوين العلماء و رءيس جامعه عبد الله بن ياسين بموريتانيا الشيخ محمد الحسن بن الددو رفقه اعضاء من منتدي كوالالمبور للفكر و الحضاره رءيس الوزراء الماليزي : الدكتور مهاتير محمد وقد ناقش المجتمعون قضايا مختلفه تهم الامه الاسلاميه من ابزرها القضايا المتعلقه بالديمقراطيه و الحريات العامه و بعض من القضايا التي تدخل ضمن اهداف منتدي كوالالمبور للفكر و الحضاره الذي يراسه رءيس الوزراء الماليزي الدكتور: مهاتير محمد ويشغل فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو فيه منصب الناءب الاول للرءيس وجري اللقاء في مدينه اسطمبول التركيه حيث يقيم فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن بن الددو وكما ناقش المجتمعون مع الرءيس الماليزي سبل النهوض وتطوير المنتدي في قابل الايام. و"منتدي كوالالمبور"، مءسسه فكريه عالميه تاسس عام 2014 في ماليزيا من طرف عدد كبير من العلماء و الشخصيات الفكريه والسياسيه في العالم العربي و الاسلامي ويهتم المنتدي بقضيه الديمقراطيه والحريات العامه اضافه الي الوساطه والمصالحه وحل ازمات العالم الاسلامي

t: Sheikh al-Dedew Delivers Courses on Sahih al-Bukhari Organised by the Ministry of Endowments and Islamic Affairs of the State of Qatar
a: الشيخ الددو يقدم دورات في صحيح البخاري تنظمها وزاره الاوقاف و الشءون الاسلاميه بدوله قطر
b:
this evening, saturday 19 october 2019, at the imam muhammad ibn abd al-wahhab mosque in doha, the first session began of the series of lessons commenting on the abridgement of sahih al-bukhari (al-tajrid al-sarih li-ahadith al-jamiʿ al-sahih by imam al-zubaydi), organised by the department of daʿwah and religious guidance at the ministry of endowments and islamic affairs of the state of qatar and delivered by his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan ould al-dedew.

the department of daʿwah and religious guidance had urged students of the religious sciences to register for this distinguished scholarly gathering, presented by one of the scholars of the muslim ummah over five consecutive days, after the maghrib prayer by doha time and lasting three consecutive hours.

for his part mr mal allah abd al-rahman al-jabir, director of the department of daʿwah and religious guidance, explained that this scholarly gathering comes within the framework of the continuing scholarly lessons, as part of the taʾsil wa-tahsil scholarly series which the department organises throughout the current year, 2019,

noting that the series would be carried live on the site of the islamic network (islamweb — islamweb).

the department took care to hold the scholarly gathering in the evening period, so as to give the largest possible number of male and female students of the religious sciences the opportunity to benefit from these important scholarly programmes, with the aim of making study easier and the acquisition of knowledge attainable within approved curricula and a systematic, foundational course of study in more than one subject of the religious sciences.

it is worth noting that the invitation to take part is open to men and women, and that certificates and licences to transmit (ijāzāt) will be distributed to those who attend the series regularly.

the first course will run for five days beginning today, saturday 19 october, and the second course will be announced later, after about a month.
r: انطلقت مساء اليوم السبت 19 اكتوبر 2019 م في جامع الامام محمد بن عبد الوهاب بالدوحه اولي حلقات سلسله دروس التعليق علي مختصر صحيح البخاري (التجريد الصريح لاحاديث الجامع الصحيح للامام الزبيدي)، المنظمه من طرف اداره الدعوه والارشاد الديني بوزاره الاوقاف والشءون الاسلاميه بدوله قطر يلقيها فضيله الشيخ : محمد الحسن ولد الددو وقد حثت اداره الدعوه والارشاد الديني طلبه العلم الشرعي علي التسجيل بهذا اللقاء العلمي المتميز، الذي يقدمه احد علماء الامه الاسلاميه علي مدي خمسه ايام متتاليه، من بعد صلاه المغرب بتوقيت الدوحه ولمده ثلاث ساعات متتاليه، من جهته اوضح السيد/ مال الله عبدالرحمن الجابر مدير اداره الدعوه والارشاد الديني ان هذا اللقاء العلمي ياتي في اطار الدروس العلميه المتجدده ضمن سلسله تاصيل وتحصيل العلميه التي تنظمها الاداره علي مدار العام الحالي 2019م، لافتا الي انه سيتم نقل هذه السلسله مباشره عبر موقع الشبكه الاسلاميه) اسلام ويب - islamweb ) وقد حرصت الاداره علي اقامه اللقاء العلمي خلال الفتره المساءيه، لاتاحه الفرصه لاكبر عدد من طلاب وطالبات العلوم الشرعيه للاستفاده من هذه البرامج العلميه الهامه ، بهدف تيسير الدراسه وتحصيل العلم ضمن مناهج معتمده ودراسه علميه تاصيليه منهجيه لاكثر من ماده في العلوم الشرعيه. تجدر الاشاره الي ان الدعوه للمشاركه متاحه للرجال والنساء، وستوزع علي المشاركين المنتظمين في هذه السلسله شهادات واجازات وستستمر الدوره الاولي مده خمسه ايام ابتداء من اليوم السبت 19 اكتوبر علي ان يعلن لاحقا عن الدوره الثانيه بعد حوالي شهر

t: Sheikh al-Dedew Meets the Fatwa Department of the Islamic Network, IslamWeb
a: الشيخ الددو يجتمع بقسم الفتوي في الشبكه الاسلاميه " اسلام ويب "
b:
on the morning of today, tuesday 22 october 2019, his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew paid a visit to the premises of the islamic network site (islamweb), located in the building of the ministry of endowments and islamic affairs in the qatari capital, doha.

those in charge of the site welcomed his eminence the sheikh, praising his role in the service of knowledge, in setting out the law of god almighty, in guarding the sanctuary of the religion, in raising high the word of truth, and in defending the causes of the muslims, and asking god, mighty and majestic, to accept this from him and to reward him on behalf of the ummah with the best of rewards.

his eminence held a scholarly meeting with those responsible for the fatwa department, in which he offered them a number of counsels, the most prominent of them being to call the intention (niyyah) to mind, the gravity of the responsibility, and the fear of god almighty, given that they sign on behalf of the lord of the worlds. his eminence the sheikh also answered some of the difficulties and questions that had come in to the network.

his eminence was shown the site's work and its committees, and prayed to god that their works be accepted and that their efforts be purely for the sake of god the generous.

this visit comes within the programme of his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew which he began some days ago with lessons commenting on the abridgement of sahih al-bukhari (al-tajrid al-sarih li-ahadith al-jamiʿ al-sahih by imam al-zubaydi), continuing for five days of each month throughout this year.

islamweb is reckoned among the largest islamic sites, containing millions of fatwas and thousands of lectures and transcribed lessons by thousands of scholars and preachers around the world.

the site belongs to the ministry of endowments and islamic affairs of the state of qatar and is supervised by a group of specialist scholars and doctors.
r: ادي فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو صباح اليوم الثلاثاء 22 اكتوبر 2019م زياره لمقر موقع الشبكه الاسلاميه ( اسلام ويب ) الواقع في مبني وزاره الاوقاف و الشءون الاسلاميه بالعاصمه القطريه الدوحه ؛ المشرفون علي الموقع رحبوا بفضيله الشيخ مشيدين بدوره في خدمه العلم و تبيان شرع الله تعالي و الذود عن حمي الدين و اعلاء كلمه الحق ، والدفاع عن قضايا المسلمين، داعين الله عز و جل ان يتقبل منه و يجازيه عن الامه خير الجزاء ؛ وقد عقد فضيلته لقاء علميا مع القاءمين علي قسم الفتوي قدم لهم فيه مجموعه من النصاءح كان من ابرزها استحضار النيه و عظم المسءوليه و الخوف من الله تعالي بصفتهم موقعين عن رب العالمين وقد اجاب فضيله الشيخ علي بعض الاشكالات و الاسءله التي وردت الشبكه .. وقد اطلع فضيله الشيخ علي عمل الموقع و لجانه داعيا الله لهم بقبول الاعمال و ان تكون جهودهم خالصه لوجه الله الكريم؛ و تاتي هذه الزياره ضمن برنامج فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو الذي بداه قبل ايام بتقديم دروس في التعليق علي علي مختصر صحيح البخاري (التجريد الصريح لاحاديث الجامع الصحيح للامام الزبيدي) تستمر لمده خمسه ايام من كل شهر طيله هذه السنه . هذا و يعتبر موقع اسلام ويب من اكبر المواقع الاسلاميه حيث يضم ملايين الفتاوي و الاف المحاضرات و الدروس المفرغه لالاف من العلماء و الدعاه حول العالم و يتبع الموقع لوزاره الاوقاف و الشءون الاسلاميه بدوله قطر و يشرف عليه مجموعه من العلماء و الدكاتره المختصين

t: The Fatwa of Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew on the Question of the Friday Prayer During the Period of Mosque Closures and the Prohibition of Friday and Congregational Prayers
a: فتوي الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في مساله صلاه الجمعه في فتره اغلاق المساجد ومنع الجمع والجماعات
b:
peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings. to proceed:

god, glorified and exalted, made the friday prayer obligatory upon the muslims. it was made obligatory while the messenger of god (peace and blessings be upon him) was in mecca, and the muslims prayed it before the hijrah, in medina, led by abu umamah asʿad ibn zurarah (may god be pleased with him) at naqiʿ al-khadamat in the lava field of banu bayadah, at hazm al-nabit, under the shade of the palms.

from that time onwards the friday prayer has been an obligatory duty upon the muslims.

god then established it in sūrat al-jumuʿah, which was sent down upon the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) in medina, and in which is the saying of god almighty: { o you who believe, when the call is made for the prayer on the day of congregation, hasten to the remembrance of god and leave off trading; that is better for you, if you only knew } (sūrat al-jumuʿah 62:9).

whoever is able to perform it, the zuhr prayer does not suffice in its place. it is obligatory upon every free, adult, resident, healthy male, so it is not obligatory upon women, nor upon those who have not reached adulthood, nor upon travellers either, nor upon the sick who are unable to attend it. al-hakim narrated in al-mustadrak from the hadith of abu saʿid al-khudri, and malik narrated it in the muwaṭṭaʾ as a mursal report: "the friday prayer is a binding duty upon every muslim in congregation, except four: a woman, a slave, a child and a traveller." the sick person too is excused by an explicit text.

so when there arises an impediment to the use of the mosques and to holding it in them, it is permissible for people to pray it in their homes, and it is permissible for three men to pray it; it does not suffice with fewer than that. this school of thought is the most probable of the schools in this matter, and its evidence is what muslim narrated in the ṣaḥīḥ from the hadith of abu saʿid al-khudri (may god be pleased with him), that the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "when they are three, let one of them lead them."

imam abd al-haqq al-ishbili (may god have mercy on him) said: this is general, covering the friday prayer and others, and there is nothing in the sharia that restricts it.

and it is the most probable position in this matter, for those who lay down the condition of forty men, and those who lay down the condition of twelve men remaining with the imam for its soundness, have no strong evidence available to them that could be relied upon.

nothing has come from the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) specifying a number for the congregation other than this hadith, and this hadith mentions three. on this basis a man may pray it in his house with his household, if there are two adult men with him, and so pray the friday prayer.

nor is the congregational mosque a condition for it, on the more probable view, contrary to the malikis. its evidence is what has already been mentioned, that the first friday prayer gathered in islam was under the shade of the palms at naqiʿ al-khadamat in the lava field of banu bayadah, and abu umamah asʿad ibn zurarah (may god be pleased with him) prayed it with the believers in medina. the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) commanded that places of prayer be taken within houses. the people of every house ought to have a prayer space in which they pray the voluntary prayers (nawāfil), and in which they pray the obligatory prayers if they have missed them, and in which, if an excuse arises for them or one of them is ill, he prays. the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) commanded it, and it is a well-known sunnah throughout the history of the whole ummah. so there is no objection to a person's praying the friday prayer with two men in that prayer space at the time of the spread of this epidemic, with the prohibition of people's gathering and the closure of the mosques; and this is not lawful in cases other than the like of these, because this belongs to the rulings of necessity (ḍarūrah). and if it is possible for the imam, the muezzin and a third with them to pray in the mosque, and for the imam to deliver the sermon to them, then there is no objection to its being transmitted over the mosque's network, or its radio, or the loudspeaker, and to people praying it at a distance in their homes, or in their shops, or in their offices, hearing the sermon by way of the loudspeaker or the radio of the mosque's network; for it suffices them too, when they are prevented from attending and prevented from entering the mosque — because when the mosque is too narrow, the friday prayer is valid in the roads connected to it, and in its forecourt, and in places where it is feasible for them to pray. on this question there is a detailed treatment which the jurists give, in which they mention four cases:

- if the mosque is too narrow and the rows are connected, there is no disagreement as to its soundness and its permissibility in the roads and the forecourt, and likewise in the houses near the mosque.

- if the mosque is spacious and the rows are not connected, the majority of them hold it not to be allowed, contrary to the narration of ibn shaʿban in the maliki school.

- if the mosque is spacious and the rows are connected, then it is void, contrary to ashhab among the malikis.

- if the mosque is too narrow and the rows are not connected, then on this question there is disagreement, on three positions:

1 — the soundness of the friday prayer;

2 — the voidness of the friday prayer;

3 — the soundness of the friday prayer together with its being disliked.

in general, what is taken from this is that people may pray in their homes if they are prevented from the mosques, and may follow the imam by his voice if they hear it, whether that be by loudspeaker, or by the radio of the mosque's network, or the like; and those further away may listen to the sermon and benefit from it.

may god honour you, prot
r: السلام عليكم ورحمه الله وبركاته اما بعد.. فان الله سبحانه وتعالي فرض علي المسلمين صلاه الجمعه، وقد فرضت ورسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم بمكه وصلاها المسلمون قبل الهجره بالمدينه يءمهم ابو امامه اسعد بن زراره ضي الله عنه بنقيع الخضمات بحره بني بياضه بهزم النبيت تحت ظلال النخل ومنذ ذلك الوقت والجمعه فريضه واجبه علي المسلمين، وقد اثبتها الله بعد ذلك في سوره الجمعه التي انزلت علي النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم بالمدينه وفيها قول الله تعالي: ﴿يا ايها الذين امنوا اذا نودي للصلاه من يوم الجمعه فاسعوا الي ذكر الله وذروا البيع ذلكم خير لكم ان كنتم تعلمون﴾ [الجمعه: ٩] ومن قدر علي اداءها لا تجزء عنها الظهر، وهي واجبه علي كل حر بالغ مقيم صحيح ذكر فلا تجب علي النساء ولا علي غير البالغين ولا علي المسافرين ايضا ولا علي الم رضي الذين لا يستطيعون شهودها و قد اخرج الحاكم في المستدرك من حديث ابي سعيد الخدري و اخرجه مالك في الموطا مرسلا: {الجمعه حق واجب علي كل مسلم في جماعه الا اربعه امراه وعبدا وصبيا ومسافرا}، والمريض كذلك معذور بالنص . فاذا جاء مانع من استغلال المساجد ومن اقامتها فيها فيجوز للناس ان يصلوها في بيوتهم، ويجوز ان يصليها ثلاثه رجال فلا تجزء باقل من ذلك، وهذا المذهب هو ارجح المذاهب في هذا الامر ودليله ما اخرج مسلم في الصحيح من حديث ابي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه ان النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم قال: {اذا كانوا ثلاثه فليءمهم احدهم}. قال الامام عبد الحق الاشبيلي رحمه الله: هذا عام في الجمعه وفي غيرها لا مخصص له من الشرع. وهو ارجح شيء في الامر، فالذين يشترطون اربعين رجلا والذين يشترطون اثني عشر رجلا باقين مع الامام لسلامها لا يسعفهم دليل قوي يمكن الركون اليه، ولم يرد عن النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم قول فيه تحديد عدد للجماعه غير هذا الحديث، وهذا الحديث فيه ذكر الثلاثه وعلي هذا يمكن ان يصليها الرجل في بيته مع اهله اذا كان معه رجلان بالغان فيصلي الجمعه، ولا يشترط لها المسجد الجامع علي الراجح ايضا خلافا للمالكيه، ودليله ما سبق ذكره ان اول جمعه جمعت في الاسلام كانت تحت ظلال النخل بنقيع الخضمات بحره بني بياضه وقد صلاها ابو امامه اسعد بن زراره رضي الله عنه بالمءمنين في المدينه. وقد امر النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم باتخاذ مساجد في البيوت. فاهل كل بيت ينبغي ان يكون لهم مصلي يصلون فيه النوافل واذا فاتتهم الفراءض صلوها فيه واذا حصل لهم عذر او م رض منهم احد يصلي فيه وقد امر به النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم وهو سنه معروفه في تاريخ الامه كلها فلا حرج ان يصلي الانسان في ذلك المصلي برجلين الجمعه في وقت انتشار هذا الوباء ومنع اجتماع الناس واغلاق المساجد، ولا يحل ذلك في غير مثل هذه الحالات لان هذا من احكام الضروره و اذا امكن ان يصلي الامام و المءذن و ثالث معهما في المسجد و خطب الامام بهم فلا مانع من نقلها عبر شبكه المسجد او مذياعه او مكبر الصوت ويصليها الناس عن بعد في بيوتهم او في متاجرهم او مكاتبهم فيسمعوا الخطبه عن طريق مكبر الصوت او مذياع شبكه المسجد فانها تجزءهم ايضا عند منعهم من الحضور ومنعهم من دخول المسجد لانه اذا ضاق المسجد اجزات الجمعه في الطرق المتصله به وفي رحبته وفي اماكن يتسير لهم فيها ان يصلوا، وفي المساله تفصيل يذكره الفقهاء فيذكرون اربع حالات: - اذا ضاق المسجد واتصلت الصفوف فلا خلاف في صحتها وجوازها في الطرق والرحبه ومثل ذلك الدور القريبه من المسجد - اذا اتسع المسجد ولم تتصل الصفوف فجمهورهم علي منعها خلافا لروايه ابن شعبان في المذهب المالكي - اذا اتسع المسجد واتصلت الصفوف فانها تبطل خلافا لاشهب من المالكيه - اذا ضاق المسجد ولم تتصل الصفوف ففي المساله خلاف علي ثلاثه اقوال: 1- صحه الجمعه 2- بطلان الجمعه 3- صحه الجمعه مع الكراهه وعموما يءخذ من هذا ان الناس يمكن ان يصلوا في بيوتهم اذا منعوا من المساجد وان يقتدوا بصوت الامام اذا سمعوه سواء كان ذلك بمكبر الصوت او بمذياع شبكه المسجد او نحو ذلك و للابعدين ان يسمعوا الخطبه وينتفعوا بها. والله يكرمكم ويحفظكم ويرعاكم والسلام عليكم ورحمه الله وبركاته.

t: The Ruling on Refraining from Cutting the Hair and Nails During the Ten Days of Dhu al-Hijjah
a: حكم الكف عن قص الشعر و الاظافر في عشر ذي الحجه
b:
as for one who has no eid sacrifice (uḍḥiyah), and for the members of a household on whose behalf the one who supports them will be sacrificing, it is permissible for them to cut their hair and their nails whenever they wish, by the agreement of the scholars.

as for one who intends to perform the sacrifice himself, the jurists have differed over him between forbiddenness, dislikedness and permissibility:

the hanbalis and some of the shafi'is held that it is forbidden (ḥarām) for him to cut his hair or his nails until he has slaughtered his sacrificial animal.

the hanafis held that it is permissible (jāʾiz) for him to do so, without its being disliked.

the malikis and the shafi'is held that it is disliked (makrūh) for him, and that refraining from cutting the hair and the nails is recommended (mandūb) and not obligatory (wājib).

the basis of this is what imam muslim narrated from umm salamah (may god be pleased with her), that the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "when you see the crescent of dhu al-hijjah, and one of you intends to sacrifice, let him refrain from his hair and his nails"; and in another narration: "let him not cut any hair nor clip any nail."

this is a prohibitive command, and a prohibitive command, when it does not entail forbiddenness, is taken to convey dislikedness. sheikh khalil said: "and it is recommended (nadb) for one who is to sacrifice to leave off shaving and clipping during the ten days of dhu al-hijjah." it is recommended only in order to resemble the pilgrim.

the malikis and the shafi'is argued that the prohibition conveys dislikedness and not forbiddenness by what imam malik and the two sheikhs [al-bukhari and muslim] narrated from aisha (may god be pleased with her), who said: "i plaited the garlands of the messenger of god's sacrificial camels with my own hands; then he marked them and garlanded them, then sent them to the house while he himself stayed in medina, and nothing that had been lawful for him became forbidden to him"; and in another narration: "then he (peace and blessings be upon him) sent them with my father" — that is, with abu bakr (may god be pleased with him), in the ninth year of the hijrah.

its meaning is: nothing of the prohibited acts of the consecrated state of pilgrimage (iḥrām) became forbidden to him — not women, nor perfume, nor removing dishevelment, nor shaving the hair, nor clipping the nails, nor anything else of what god has made lawful…

and god knows best.
r: بالنسبه لمن لا اضحيه له و لافراد الاسره الذين سيضحي عنهم كافلهم يجوز لهم ان ياخذوا من الشعر و الاظفار متي شاءوا باتفاق العلماء. اما بالنسبه لمن يريد ان يضحي بنفسه فقد اختلف الفقهاء فيه بين الحرمه والكراهه والاباحه: فراي الحنابله وبعض الشافعيه انه يحرم عليه الاخذ من الشعر و الاظافر حتي يذكي اضحيته و راي الحنفيه انه يجوز له ذلك من غير كراهه و راي المالكيه والشافعيه انه يكره له ذلك وان ترك الاخذ من الشعر و الاظافر مندوب وليس بواجب ، والاصل في ذلك ما روي الامام مسلم عن ام سلمه -رضي الله عنها- ان النبيﷺ قال: «اذا رايتم هلال ذي الحجه، واراد احدكم ان يضحي فليمسك عن شعره واظفاره»، وفي روايه: «فلا ياخذن شعرا ولا يقلمن ظفرا» وهذا نهي والنهي اذا لم يقتض التحريم حمل علي الكراهه قال الشيخ خليل: "و(ندب) ترك حلق وقلم لمضح عشر ذي الحجه"، وانما ندب للتشبه بالحاج، واستدل المالكيه والشافعيه علي ان النهي للكراهه وليس للتحريم بما روي الامام مالك والشيخان عن عاءشه -رضي الله عنها- قالت: «انا فتلت قلاءد بدن رسول اللهﷺ بيدي، ثم اشعرها وقلدها، ثم بعث بها الي البيت واقام بالمدينه، فما حرم عليه شيء كان له حلا»، وفي روايه: «ثم بعث بهاﷺ مع ابي»؛ اي مع ابي بكر رضي الله عنه في السنه التاسعه من الهجره ومعناه: فما حرم عليه شيء من محظورات الاحرام؛ من النساء، والطيب، وازاله الشعث، وحلق الشعر، وتقليم الاظفار، وغير ذلك مما احله الله... والله اعلم

t: Sheikh al-Dedew’s Commendation of the Book Irshad al-Maharah fi Asanid al-Mahdarah by the Learned Shaykh Muhammad Yahzih ibn Muhammad Ali
a: تقريظ الشيخ الددو لكتاب ارشاد المهره في اسانيد المحضره للشيخ العلامه محمد يحظيه بن محمد عالي
b:
sheikh al-dedew's commendation of the book *irshad al-maharah fi asanid al-mahdarah* by the learned shaykh muhammad yahzih ibn muhammad ali.

the commendation of the eminent sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew of the book *irshad al-maharah fi asanid al-mahdarah*, by the eminent and learned shaykh muhammad yahzih ibn muhammad ali ibn muhammad fal ibn naam al-abd al-majlisi.

[verse. rendered as prose, line by line; the arabic is the operative text.]

*a noble book, exalted in the world of books, which broke new ground in the history of the western flank,*

*and closed a gap that stood in our libraries, by joining up the chains of transmission (asānīd) of the traditional schools and of the books,*

*and spread out again what the long passage of time had folded away and buried of the traces of its conquering lions,*

*and guided the skilled and the rightly directed to the most profitable ways of travelling in the track of the caravan.*

*by it the shaykh, the imam, brought to light wonders at which one marvels — wonders that guide, and that cure a man of marvelling.*

*muhammad yahzih, the noble, is our lamp, first past the post in the race of knowledge across the wide and open waste,*

*the halting-place where students unload their mounts, one practised at laying the tar-salve exactly where the mange is,*

*such that in him knowledge, understanding and god-consciousness (taqwā) stand side by side with generosity and good character,*

*together with an elevated literary art, finely turned verse, and a refined taste that never strays from the road —*

*all of it joined to a lineage of towering honour and glory, risen from noble stock by the steep ascent.*

*abu ahmad, the noble and ready man, was their father; glory has been passed down from him, ready man to ready man.*

*their breasts were created as vessels for understanding, and their lifetimes for occupation with the obligatory (farḍ) and the recommended (nadb);*

*their feet for outstripping others on the paths of eminence, and their hands for giving, for enquiry and for writing.*

*in glory, honour and eminence they have reached the furthest ranks, not to be approached even by the noblest of men;*

*and in the awe-inspiring assembly of learning they took the middle place, at a forefront where they stood as the heart stands.*

*at the dome of islam is the stronghold of their honour, under a lucky star and in a spacious dwelling.*

*so too the house of naam al-abd have been a blessing to people, level-spread in their hospitality, like a sweet watering place:*

*obeyed in the thick of battle, lamps in the darkness, keys to what is locked, deliverers from distress.*

*and this shaykh follows his father in his qualities, matching him in every title to glory, or surpassing him.*

*time has begrudged the world the like of his writings; their precedence is assured, far and near.*

*it is as though abu hayyan meant his books by the lines he spoke in al-bahr wa-l-darb:*

*"easterly risings of lights that shone forth at ceuta — and what a wonder, that the risings should appear in the west!"*

*a fertile pasture amid the barrenness of its lands — marvel, then, at fertility in the place of drought!*

*for regions have no merit except through their men; failing that, no soil has any merit over soil.*
r: تقريظ الشيخ الددو لكتاب ارشاد المهره في اسانيد المحضره للشيخ العلامه محمد يحظيه بن محمد عالي تقريظ فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو لكتاب ارشاد المهره في اسانيد المحضره لفضيله الشيخ العلامه محمد يحظيه بن محمد عالي بن محمد فال بن نعم العبد المجلسي كتاب جليل جل في عالم الكتب و جدد في التاريخ في المنكب الغربي و سد فراغا كان في مكتباتنا بوصل اسانيد المحاضر و الكتب و انشر ما قد كان طول المدي طوي و اقبر من اثار اسادها الغلب و ارشد اصحاب المهاره و الهدي لانفع طرق السير في اثر الركب و ابدي به الشيخ الامام عجاءبا بها عجب يهدي و يشفي من العجب محمد يحظيه الكريم سراجنا مجلي سباق العلم في السبسب السهب محط رحال الدارسين مجرب لوضع الهناء في مواضع ذي النقب بحيث يقاني العلم و الفهم و التقي مع الجود و الاخلاق جنبا الي جنب مع الادب الراقي و شعر مهذب و ذوق رفيع لا يحيد عن الدرب الي نسب في العز و المجد باذخ ترقي من الاعياص في المرتقي الصعب ابو احمد الندب الكريم ابوهم تناقل عنه المجد ندب الي ندب و قد خلقت للفهم ظرفا صدورهم و اعمارهم للشغل بالفرض و الندب و ارجلهم للسبق في سبل العلي و ايديهم للبذل و البحث و الكتب لقد بلغوا في المجد و العز و العلي مراتب قصوي لا تقرب بالنجب و في مجلس العلم المهيب توسطوا بصدر به كانوا بمنزله القلب لدي قبه الاسلام معقل عزهم علي الطاءر الميمون و المنزل الرحب كما ال نعم العبد للناس نعمه موطاه الاكناف كالمنهل العذب مطاعين في الهيجا مصابيح في الدجي مفاتيح اغلاق مفاريج للكرب و ذا الشيخ يقفو من ابيه شماءلا يساويه في كل المفاخر او يربي تاليفه ضن الزمان بمثلها لها السبق مضمون علي البعد و القرب كان ابا حيان يقصد كتبه بابياته اذ قال في البحر و الضرب مشارق انوار تبدت بسبته فواعجبا تبدو المشارق بالغرب و مرعي خصيب في جديب ربوعها الا فاعجبوا للخصب في موضع الجدب فما فضل الارجاء الا رجالها و الا فلا فضل لترب علي ترب

t: A Welcome to Mauritania’s Guest, al-Sayyid al-Mustafa ibn al-Imam al-Shafiʻi
a: ترحيب بضيف موريتانيا السيد المصطفي بن الامام الشافعي
b:
[verse. rendered as prose, line by line; the arabic is the operative text.]

*my country bids welcome to the noble and beneficent one, al-mustafa, son of the imam al-shafi'i,*

*to the eloquent one, the valiant and resolute champion, the well-pleasing, possessed of honour and of high and far-spread renown,*

*the close companion of manliness, of noble deeds and high aspiration, of open-handedness and of fine and splendid character;*

*one who comes to the aid of the wronged without hesitation, and looses the bonds of the abject soul who calls for help.*

*in his favours and his gifts he makes no distinction between the importunate and the chaste and contented man:*

*each receives his share of his bounty, with a cheerful face, with affection and with humility.*

*he inherited these noble qualities from forefathers of honour, whose eminence spread through the widest reaches.*

*the noble ones of the line of jakar have hedged their titles to glory about with a broad edifice;*

*their present state points back to their past, and their past points forward to this present state.*

*they are the buyers of every noble quality and every height, and they bid the price up high for the seller.*

*knowledge is in them, and courage, and right guidance, and generosity, together with a widely known nobility of soul —*

*an inheritance passed down through the length of time, its hardships and all, from the one followed to the one who follows.*

*jakan are the pillars of the sciences, the qiblah of the wronged, his place of safety and the honour of the lowly.*

*their honour is inviolable and guarded, and their goods are apportioned out like things held in trust.*

*in every age they raise up for our people a banner of knowledge, pointed to like a shining star.*

*so may god grant them victory, and keep your memory alive, and make their favour endure in unbroken good.*
r: وطني يرحب بالكريم النافع المصطفي نجل الامام الشافعي بالمصقع البطل الهمام المرتضي ذي العز و الذكر الرفيع الذاءع خدن المروءه و المكارم و العلي و الجود و الخلق الجميل الراءع من ينصر المظلوم دون تردد و يفك اسر المستغيث الخانع لا فرق في افضاله و نواله بين اللجوج و ذي العفاف القانع كل ينال نصيبه من سيبه ببشاشه و تحبب و تواضع ورث المكارم عن ابين اعزه شاعت علاهم في الفضاء الشاسع ان الاكارم من سلاله جاكر حاطوا المفاخر بالبناء الواسع فيدل واقعهم علي ماضيهم و يدل ماضيهم علي ذا الواقع هم مشترو كل المكارم و العلي يغلون في اثمانها للباءع فالعلم فيهم و الشجاعه و الهدي و الجود مع شرف النفوس الشاءع ارث يورثه علي طول المدي و صعابه متبوعهم للتابع جاكان اركان العلوم و قبله ال مظلوم مامنه و عز الخاضع اعراضهم معصومه محفوظه و عروضهم مقسومه كوداءع في كل عصر يظهرون لشعبنا علما يشار له كنجم ساطع فالله ينصرهم و يبقي ذكركم و يديم نعمتهم بخير تتابع

t: Sheikh al-Dedew’s Elegy for Shaykh al-Din ibn Muhammad Ali ibn Takrur
a: مرثيه الشيخ الددو للشيخ الدين بن محمد علي ابن تكرور
b:
[verse. rendered as prose, line by line; the arabic is the operative text.]

*is it truly al-din whose death you have announced — he of religion and right guidance, of knowledge and character, of glory and open-handedness;*

*he of the well-pleasing way, and of those sunnah practices for which he held a chain of transmission going back to the messenger of god;*

*defending them, repudiating every innovation in religion (bidʿah), and no faint-heart, however many the enemies grew;*

*he who among us took the lead in understanding and in quickness of mind, and who among us ran the whole course in his noble deeds;*

*who put knowledge and mastery into the hands of generations, and so accustomed them to it that it became their habit;*

*who was a ready man, eloquent of speech, foremost in place, honoured, firmly established, a chief among his clan,*

*high-minded, upright, his honour never to be slighted; a doer, a speaker, upholding what is right.*

*if al-din has departed from us, following after his companions, and has left a numbing grief in our souls —*

*then he has not died who has left his sons and his household behind him, and he has not died who has left a praise that endures.*

*so take patience, noble sons of musa, our shaykhs and our masters: may every one of us be your ransom.*

*may you never cease to be a wellspring of religion and knowledge, and a watering place of generosity, character and honour.*

*our beloved ones, o house of amina, be patient: al-din among you is not one man — he is many.*

*you remain for us a cave of refuge, a strength and a haven, and for religion, character and knowledge a root stock.*

*may my lord lodge al-din in the noblest of lodgings, and place his record in his right hand tomorrow,*

*and settle him in the highest garden as a neighbour to his forefather, the messenger of guidance — how true a seat is that!*

*and may my god bless his sons and their mother, and his two daughters; and may he keep them, honour them and give them happiness.*

*and may he send blessings upon the best of mankind, and upon his family, his companions, and the rightly guided who followed them.*
r: احقا نعيت الدين ذا الدين و الهدي و ذا العلم و الاخلاق و المجد و الندي و ذا السنن المرضي و السنن التي لها عن رسول الله قد كان مسندا ينافح عنها منكرا كل بدعه و ليس بهياب و لو كثر العدي و من حاز فينا السبق في الفهم و الذكا و من جاز فينا في مكارمه المدي و من اكسب الاجيال علما و سءددا و عودهم من ذاك ما قد تعودا و من كان ندبا مصقعا متصدرا عزيزا مكينا في العشيره سيدا نبيها نزيها لا يضام جنابه فعولا قءولا للصواب مءيدا لءن سار عنا الدين اثر رفاقه وخلف حزنا في النفوس تبلدا فما مات من ابقي بنيه و اله و ما مات من ابقي ثناء مخلدا و صبرا بني موسي الكرام شيوخنا و سادتنا انا لكم كلنا فدا فلا زلتم للدين و العلم مصدرا و للجود و الاخلاق و العز موردا احبتنا يا ال امنه اصبروا فما الدين فيكم واحد بل تعددا بقيتم لنا كهفا و عزا و موءلا و للدين و الاخلاق و العلم محتدا و انزل ربي الدين اكرم منزل و اعطاه باليمني صحيفته غدا و اسكنه الفردوس جارا لجده رسول الهدي يا صدق ذلك مقعدا و بارك الهي في بنيه و امهم و بنتيه و احفظهم و اكرم و اسعدا و صل علي خير الانام و اله و اصحابه و التابعين ذوي الهدي

t: Sheikh al-Dedew's Prayer for the Recovery of His Eminence the Learned Sheikh Muhammad Mahmud Ahmad Yura al-Rabbani
a: استشفاء الشيخ الددو لفضيله الشيخ العلامه محمد محمود احمد يوره الرباني
b:
o our lord, heal our sheikh muhammad

mahmud, who has traversed the farthest reach in excellence,

of the line of ahmad yura, who stood alone

in knowledge and in character, and so was without peer,

the most radiant of face and the most noble of descent,

the most truthful in speech and the most open-handed,

the finest in conduct and the highest in chain of transmission,

the purest of heart and the most exacting in purpose.

he has built a glory for the two forefathers, long inherited,

clothed in generosity, the imams of guidance.

lord, grant him what he seeks and what he aims at,

preserve him and help him with a strengthening help,

and in his sons let what has been customary continue,

that they stand, one master after another.

grant maryam the wish that will make her happy,

answer this supplication, and subdue the enemies.
r: يا ربنا اشف شيخنا محمدا محمودا الجاءز في الفضل المدي سلسل احمد يوره من تفردا في العلم والخلق فكان الاوحدا انور وجها واجل محتدا اصدق لهجه واكرم يدا احسن سيره واعلي سندا اطهر قلبا وادق مقصدا قد شاد مجدا للابين اتلدا في حله الجود اءمه الهدي رب انله المبتغي والمقصدا وابقه وانصره نصرا ايدا وفي البنين ابق ما تعودا يقفون ذاك سيدا فسيدا و اعط مريم مناها المسعدا و استجب الدعاء و اكبت العدي

t: The Ruling on Selling Imported Food Before It Reaches the Merchant's Warehouses | Fatwas of Sheikh al-Dedew
a: حكم بيع الطعام المستورد قبل وصوله مخازن التاجر | فتاوي الشيخ الددو
b:
a questioner asks about the ruling on selling imported food before it reaches the merchant's warehouses, and whether this falls under the prohibition of selling food before taking possession of it (qabḍ); and, on that basis, if he sells it and its price rises before it arrives, whether the seller may rescind the sale or raise the price.

and upon you be peace, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

as to selling food before it arrives: if it has already entered the seller's ownership and his liability (ḍamān), so that it is owned by him and is no longer owned by the company from which he bought it — as where it was he who shipped it by sea and he who insured it — then it is permissible for him to sell it, because it has come into his ownership and his possession, even if it has not reached the market, even if it has not reached the country at all, and even if it is loaded on board at sea; before it reaches the port it is permissible for him to sell it. and once he has sold it, it is not lawful for him to go back on his sale, because the sale has already taken effect, even if the price rises afterwards. for god, glorified and exalted, says: { o you who believe, fulfil your contracts } (sūrat al-māʾidah 5:1); and he says: { and those who fulfil their covenant when they make a covenant } (sūrat al-baqarah 2:177); and the glorified and exalted says: { and fulfil the covenant of god when you have made a covenant } (sūrat al-naḥl 16:91). it is established as sound from the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) that he said: "the signs of the hypocrite are three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks his promise, and when he is entrusted he betrays the trust" — narrated by al-bukhari. and it is established as sound from him (peace and blessings be upon him) that he said: "four traits: whoever has them in him is a pure hypocrite, and whoever has one of them has in him a trait of hypocrisy until he abandons it — when he is entrusted he betrays the trust, when he speaks he lies, when he makes a covenant he acts treacherously, and when he disputes he behaves depravedly" — narrated by al-bukhari.

may god protect us and you from hypocrisy, from discord and from bad character, and may he make what he has made lawful suffice us and you, so that we have no need of what he has forbidden.

and peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

fatwas of his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew al-shinqiti
r: ساءل يسال عن حكم بيع الطعام المستورد قبل وصوله مخازن التاجر وهل يدخل ضمن حرمه بيع الطعام قبل قبضه و علي ذلك اذا باعه فارتفع سعره قبل وصوله فهل للباءع فسخ البيع او رفع السعر . عليكم السلام ورحمه الله وبركاته بيع الطعام قبل وصوله اذا كان قد دخل في ملك الباءع و ضمانه فكان مملوكا له ولم يعد مملوكا للشركه التي اشتراه منها، بان كان هو الذي شحنه في البحر وهو الذي امن عليه فانه يجوز له بيعه لانه اصبح في ملكه وحوزه ولو لم يصل الي السوق ولو لم يصل الي البلد اصلا ولو كان مشحونا في البحر وقبل ان يصل الي الميناء يجوز له بيعه، واذا باعه لا يحل له التراجع عن بيعه، لان البيع قد مضي ولو ارتفع السعر بعد ذلك فان الله سبحانه وتعالي يقول: { يا ايها الذين امنوا اوفوا بالعقود } و يقول : { والموفون بعهدهم اذا عاهدوا } و يقول سبحانه وتعالي{ واوفوا بعهد الله اذا عاهدتم } وقد صح عن النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم انه قال: « ايه المنافق ثلاث: اذا حدث كذب، واذا وعد اخلف، واذا اءتمن خان » رواه البخاري و صح عنه صلي الله عليه وسلم انه قال : « اربع من كن فيه كان منافقا خالصا، ومن كانت فيه خصله منهن كانت فيه خصله من النفاق حتي يدعها: اذا اءتمن خان، واذا حدث كذب، واذا عاهد غدر، واذا خاصم فجر » رواه البخاري . اجارنا الله و اياكم من النفاق و الشقاق و سوء الاخلاق و اغنانا و اياكم بحلاله عن حرامه. و السلام عليكم ورحمه الله وبركاته فتاوي فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو الشنقيطي

t: His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew Congratulates Sheikh Muhammad Sidiya (al-Nawawi) Ould Sulayman Ould Ajdud on the Welcome of His Beloved Son Abdullah — May God Almighty Preserve Them Both
a: قال فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو مهنءا الشيخ محمد سيديا (النووي) ولد سليمان ولد اجدود ترحيبا بابنه الغالي عبد الله، حفظهما الله تعالي
b:
his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew said, congratulating sheikh muhammad sidiya (al-nawawi) ould sulayman ould ajdud in welcome of his beloved son abdullah — may god almighty preserve them both:

o abdullah, live out an age that is praiseworthy,

noble, honoured, dutiful and happy.

be like your father, a scholar of every discipline,

and one who restores the sunnah practices that have fallen into disuse.

hold fast to the upright way and guard it,

and you will never swerve from the middle of the road.

recite the qur'an measuredly; that was their constant practice,

the practice of the forefathers, their long-inherited way.

may god give you of what he gave them,

and increase you in elevation and in further guidance.

be a shade for the sheikh, and gather what he has

gathered for the students, and so be of benefit.

hasten to acts of nobility and to high things,

and live in his shade a life of ease.

strive for the victory of the truth, and be brave

like your noble family, and die a martyr.
r: قال فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو مهنءا الشيخ محمد سيديا (النووي) ولد سليمان ولد اجدود ترحيبا بابنه الغالي عبد الله، حفظهما الله تعالي اعبد الله عش قرنا حميدا كريما مكرما برا سعيدا و كن كابيك عالم كل فن و للسنن المماته مستعيدا و للنهج القويم الزم و صنه فعن وسط المحجه لن تحيدا و للقران رتل ذاك داب للابا كان دابهم التليدا حباك الله مما قد حباهم و زادك رفعه و هدي مزيدا و كن للشيخ ظلا و احو ما قد حوي للطالبين فكن مفيدا و سارع للمكارم و المعالي و عش في ظله عيشا رغيدا لنصر الحق فاسع و كن شجاعا كاهليك الكرام و مت شهيدا

t: Sheikh al-Dedew's Congratulation to His Eminence Sheikh al-Nawawi, and the Reply of His Eminence Sheikh Abdullah Ajdud, "al-ʿAbbad"
a: تهنءه الشيخ الددو لفضيله الشيخ النووي و جواب فضيله الشيخ عبد الله اجدود " العباد *
b:
his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew said, congratulating sheikh muhammad sidiya (al-nawawi) ould sulayman ould ajdud in welcome of his beloved son abdullah — may god almighty preserve them both:

o abdullah, live out an age that is praiseworthy,

noble, honoured, dutiful and happy.

be like your father, a scholar of every discipline,

and one who restores the sunnah practices that have fallen into disuse.

hold fast to the upright way and guard it,

and you will never swerve from the middle of the road.

recite the qur'an measuredly; that was their constant practice,

the practice of the forefathers, their long-inherited way.

may god give you of what he gave them,

and increase you in elevation and in further guidance.

be a shade for the sheikh, and gather what he has

gathered for the students, and so be of benefit.

hasten to acts of nobility and to high things,

and live in his shade a life of ease.

strive for the victory of the truth, and be brave

like your noble family, and die a martyr.

the answer and reply of his eminence sheikh abdullah "al-ʿabbad" ibn sulayman ibn ajdud, adviser to the minister of endowments and islamic affairs in the state of qatar, to his eminence sheikh al-dedew's congratulation to the learned al-nawawi — may god almighty preserve them — was as follows:

peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

may god greet you, his eminence the sheikh, and preserve you and keep you.

from the moment the limpid and splendid piece of verse reached me, which you sent me as a congratulation and a supplication for our blessed son — god almighty willing — abdullah, i have been in the utmost delight and joy at it.

it has taken a place with all of us that none knows but god almighty, and we count it among the glories of this world for us, and we hope it will be among that by which the treasure of the hereafter is attained.

i have composed some verses, despite how long it has been since i last wrote poetry — perhaps more than thirty years, praise be to god — and i do not think they do it justice, nor match it in form or in meaning, nor rise to its measure. the verses are:

o abdullah, your good fortune admits of no addition

beyond what it is, so be glad and happy with it.

vaunt yourself before the gatherings of the young, since

sheikh al-dedew has prayed that you become a master.

he went to the utmost in congratulating you, and adorned

your kin with a matchless necklace of eminence.

so reward him, lord, with a good recompense, and multiply

for him, on our behalf, his reward, and add to it.

and grant him, lord, all that he hopes for,

removing from him every harm, far away.

o sheikh of sheikhs, and pride of an age

that god favoured with your glorious rising —

i forsook poetry long ago, and it is now

a duty upon me that my return to it be praiseworthy.
r: قال فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو مهنءا الشيخ محمد سيديا (النووي) ولد سليمان ولد اجدود ترحيبا بابنه الغالي عبد الله، حفظهما الله تعالي اعبد الله عش قرنا حميدا كريما مكرما برا سعيدا و كن كابيك عالم كل فن و للسنن المماته مستعيدا و للنهج القويم الزم و صنه فعن وسط المحجه لن تحيدا و للقران رتل ذاك داب للابا كان دابهم التليدا حباك الله مما قد حباهم و زادك رفعه و هدي مزيدا و كن للشيخ ظلا و احو ما قد حوي للطالبين فكن مفيدا و سارع للمكارم و المعالي و عش في ظله عيشا رغيدا لنصر الحق فاسع و كن شجاعا كاهليك الكرام و مت شهيدا فكان جواب و رده فضيله الشيخ عبد الله " العباد " بن سليمان بن اجدود مستشار وزير الاوقاف و الشءون الاسلاميه بدوله قطر علي تهنءه فضيله الشيخ الددو للعلامه النوويه - حفظهم الله تعالي السلام عليكم ورحمه الله وبركاته حياكم فضيله الشيخ وحفظكم وابقاكم منذ وصلتني القطعه الشعريه الراءقه الراءعه التي ارسلتم لي تهنءه ودعاء لابننا المبارك - ان شاء الله تعالي - عبد الله وانا في غايه السرور والابتهاج بها. وقد وقعت منا جميعا موقعا لا يعلمه الا الله تعالي، واننا لنعتبرها لنا من مفاخر الدنيا ونرجو ان تكون مما ينال به مدخر الاخره. وقد قلت ابياتا رغم تقادم عهدي بقرض الشعر، - ربما يكون ذلك ازيد من ثلاثين سنه لله الحمد - واعتقد انها لا توفيها حقها، ولا تكافءها في مبناها ومعناها، ولا تساميها في قدرها. والابيات هي: اعبد الله حظك لا مزيدا عليه فكن به جذلا سعيدا وباه محافل الولدان لما دعا الشيخ الدوو لك ان تسودا وبالغ فيك تهنءه وحلي ذويك من العلا عقدا فريدا فجازه رب صالحه وضاعف له عنا مثوبته وزيدا واعطه رب ما يرجوه طرا مزيحا عنه كل اذي بعيدا ايا شيخ الشيوخ وفخر عصر حباه الله مطلعك المجيدا هجرت الشعر مذ زمن وحق علي الان عودته حميدا.

t: Sheikh al-Dedew's Commendation of the Book The Genealogical Tree of the Idrisids of Sidi Yahya, by the Noble Sayyid Sheikh Muhammad al-Mukhtar ibn Ahmad ibn Abd al-Da'im, May God Preserve Him
a: تقريظ الشيخ الددو لكتاب ( شجره الادارسه سيدي يحيي ) للسيد الشريف الشيخ محمد المختار بن احمد بن عبد الداءم حفظه الله
b:
i said, in commendation of the book the genealogical tree of the idrisids of sidi yahya, by the noble sayyid, sheikh muhammad al-mukhtar ibn ahmad ibn abd al-da'im, may god preserve him:

muhammad al-mukhtar, possessor of knowledge and excellence,

of righteousness, kindness, generosity and open-handed giving;

possessor of a high and noble lineage, and of god-consciousness (taqwā),

of the most exemplary traits and of an easy disposition.

his forefathers bequeathed him every excellence,

and through his maternal uncles it was perfected, excellence upon excellence:

from the family of abd al-da'im he gained eminence,

and from the righteous family of al-zuwayn, people of nobility.

he has books that hold precious treasures,

beautiful in their arrangement, sound in what they transmit.

he has set out from the genealogies a detailed volume

that helps those of us who are kin to keep the ties of kinship.

he has given the lives of notable figures, verified attributions of descent,

made homelands clear, and enumerated the offspring.

it holds a clear account of the genealogies of tanwajiw

for their descendants, so that like is joined to like.

and he traces the branches of the pole (quṭb) sidi yahya back

to sidi idris, of original nobility,

to his father idris, of glory and eminence,

to the excellent abdullah, of merit and justice,

to al-hasan the excellent, al-muthanna, who rose to

the summits of might, of divine enabling, of forbearance and of sound judgement,

to al-hasan the grandson, son of haydara the well-pleasing,

through fatimah al-zahra, to the master of the messengers —

upon him be god's blessings without ceasing, and upon his family,

and the purest peace, joining the branch to the root.

written by muhammad al-hasan ibn al-dedew.
r: قلت في تقريظ كتاب ( شجره الادارسه سيدي يحيي ) للسيد الشريف الشيخ محمد المختار بن احمد بن عبد الداءم حفظه الله محمد المختار ذو العلم و الفضل و ذو البر و الاحسان و الجود و البذل و ذو النسب العالي الشريف و ذو التقي و ذو الشيم المثلي و ذو الخلق السهل قد اورثه الاباء كل فضيله و كمل بالاخوال فضلا علي فضل فمن ال عبد الداءم اكتسب العلي و ال الزوين الصالحين ذوي النبل له كتب تحوي كنوزا ثمينه جميله ترتيب مصححه النقل ابان من الانساب سفرا مفصلا يعين ذوي الارحام منا علي الوصل و ترجم اعلاما و حقق نسبه و بين اوطانا و عدد للنسل لانساب تنواجيو يحوي مبينا لاحفادهم فالشكل ينضم للشكل و للقطب سيدي يحي ينهي فروعه الي سيدي ادريس ذي الشرف الاصلي لوالده ادريس ذي المجد و العلي الي الندب عبد الله ذي الفضل و العدل الي الحسن الندب المثني من ارتقي ذري العز و التوفيق و الحلم و العقل الي الحسن السبط ابن حيدره الرضا لفاطمه الزهرا الي سيد الرسل عليه صلاه الله تتري و اله و ازكي سلام يجمع الفصل بالاصل كتبه محمد الحسن بن الددو

t: Taking In Public Lectures, Classes and Fatwa Sessions — Sheikh al-Dedew on a Da'wah Tour to the Mauritanian Region of Dakhlet Nouadhibou
a: تشمل اقامه محاضرات ودروس وحلقات افتاء.. الشيخ الددو في رحله دعويه الي ولايه داخلت انواذيبو الموريتانيه
b:
his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew — head of the centre for the formation of scholars, president of the al-mustaqbal association, and a member of the board of trustees of the international union of muslim scholars — delivered a scholarly lecture entitled "the factors of the ummah's strength", as part of a series of lectures and classes hosted by mauritania's economic capital, the region of dakhlet nouadhibou, which lies 470 km from the capital nouakchott.

this event comes as part of a da'wah tour in the region organised by the al-mustaqbal association for da'wah, culture and education on 25 and 26 june of this month; the tour takes in a series of lectures, classes and fatwa sessions.

these are the principal lectures, in chronological order:

in the district of chami:

* the first lecture: "lawful earning", at the al-furqan congregational mosque in the district of chami, which opened the da'wah tour.

* a fatwa session specifically for gold prospectors and those working in prospecting, in which sheikh al-dedew answered the questions of those present.

and in the district of nouadhibou:

* a lecture at the quba mosque on "coming to the prophet's aid, god bless him and grant him peace, and what that requires".

* a lecture entitled "how do we pray the prayer of the prophet, god bless him and grant him peace?", at the al-ridwan mosque. — organised by the al-furqan association for culture and upbringing.

* a lecture entitled "the factors of the ummah's strength", at the abu bakr al-siddiq congregational mosque.

* "the merit of the ten days of dhu al-hijjah", organised by the women's association for combating poverty and illiteracy.

* the duty of the muslim young woman in coming to the aid of the prophet, god bless him and grant him peace — organised by the al-fatat association for awareness and upbringing.
r: القي فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رءيس مركز تكوين العلماء و رءيس جمعيه المستقبل وعضو مجلس امناء الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين محاضره علميه بعنوان: "عوامل قوه الامه"، ضمن سلسله محاضرات ودروس تحتضنها العاصمه الاقتصاديه لموريتانيا ولايه داخلت نواذيبو التي تبعد عن العاصمه انواكشوط 470 كلم. وتاتي هذه الفعاليه ضمن رحله دعويه في الولايه نظمتها جمعيه المستقبل للدعوه والثقافه والتعليم يومي 25 و 26 يونيو الجاري، وتشمل الرحله اقامه سلسله من المحاضرات والدروس وحلقات الافتاء. وهذه ابرز المحاضرات حسب التسلسل الزمني :- ففي مقاطعه الشامي: * المحاضره الاولي: "الكسب الحلال" في جامع الفرقان بمقاطعه الشامي التي كانت مفتتح الرحله الدعويه. * حلقه افتاء خاصه بالمنقبين عن الذهب والعاملين في مجال التنقيب، حيث اجاب الشيخ الددو علي اسءله الحضور. وفي مقاطعه انواذيبو: * محاضره في مسجد قباء عن "نصره النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم ومقتضياتها". * محاضره بعنوان: "كيف نصلي صلاه النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم؟" في مسجد الرضوان. - الجهه المنظمه جمعيه الفرقان للثقافه والتربيه. * محاضره بعنوان: "عوامل قوه الامه" في جامع ابي بكر الصديق. * "فضل عشر ذي الحجه" الجهه المنظمه الجمعيه النسويه لمكافحه الفقر والاميه. * واجب الفتاه المسلمه في نصره النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم - الجهه المنظمه جمعيه الفتاه للتوعيه والتربيه.

t: From Muhammad al-Hasan ibn al-Dedew to Every Muslim Whom This Reaches
a: من محمد الحسن بن الددو الي كل من يصل اليه من المسلمين
b:
peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

to proceed: among the best seasons of good in the year is this season with which god has favoured you in these days of merit, which are the best days of the year. the group narrated — except muslim and al-nasa'i — from the hadith of ibn abbas, may god be pleased with them both, who said: the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, said: «there are no days in which righteous deeds are more beloved to god, mighty and majestic, than these days» — meaning the ten days of dhu al-hijjah. and ahmad and others narrated from the hadith of ibn umar, may god be pleased with them both, who said: the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, said: «there are no days greater in the sight of god, glorified is he, nor in which deeds are more beloved to him, than these ten days; so do much in them of declaring god's oneness, of declaring his greatness and of praising him.» so exert yourselves in righteous deeds in these days, and especially in the following:

1 - fasting all of them. ahmad and al-nasa'i narrated from hafsa bint umar, may god be pleased with them both, who said: «four things the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, did not leave: the fast of ashura, the ten days, three days of every month, and the two cycles before the morning meal.» what is meant is all but the day of eid, for fasting it is not lawful. for this reason abu dawud narrated from one of the wives of the prophet, god bless him and grant him peace, who said: «the prophet, god bless him and grant him peace, used to fast the nine days of dhu al-hijjah, the day of ashura, three days of every month, and the first monday of the month, and the thursdays.» as for the hadith of aisha with muslim: «i never saw the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, fasting in the ten days at all.» — that is to be understood as referring to the hajj.

2 - fasting the day of arafah in particular, for one who is not on hajj. muslim, ahmad, abu dawud and ibn majah narrated from abu qatada, may god be pleased with him, who said: the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, said: «fasting the day of arafah expiates two years, one past and one to come; and fasting the day of ashura expiates one past year.» and in another wording: «i reckon upon god that he will expiate the year before it and the year after it.»

3 - doing much remembrance of god. al-bukhari said in the ṣaḥīḥ: «and ibn abbas said: {and that they may mention the name of god on the appointed days} (sūrat al-ḥajj 22:28) — the days of the ten. he said: and ibn umar and abu hurayra used to go out to the market during the days of the ten, declaring god's greatness, and the people would declare his greatness at their declaring it.» and there has already come, in the hadith of ibn umar, the instruction to do much of declaring god's oneness, declaring his greatness and praising him.

4 - that one who is going to offer the eid sacrifice (uḍḥiyah) not take anything from his hair or his nails from the beginning of the month until he has sacrificed, in resemblance to one in the consecrated state of pilgrimage (muḥrim). the group narrated — except al-bukhari — from the hadith of umm salama, may god be pleased with her, that the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, said: «whoever has an animal to slaughter that he is going to slaughter — when the crescent of dhu al-hijjah appears, let him not take anything from his hair or his nails until he has sacrificed.»

and god grant us and you every good, and accept from us and from you.

written by muhammad al-hasan ibn al-dedew, may god be for him a protector and a helper
r: السلام عليكم و رحمه الله و بركاته اما بعد فان من افضل مواسم الخير في السنه هذا الموسم الذي امتن الله به عليكم في هذه الايام الفاضله التي هي افضل ايام السنه، فقد اخرج الجماعه الا مسلما و النساءي من حديث ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما، قال: قال رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم : «ما من ايام العمل الصالح فيها احب الي الله عز وجل من هذه الايام. يعني عشر ذي الحجه» واخرج احمد و غيره من حديث ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم: «ما من ايام اعظم عند الله سبحانه ولا احب اليه العمل فيهن من هذه الايام العشر، فاكثروا فيهن من التهليل والتكبير والتحميد.» فاجتهدوا في الاعمال الصالحه في هذه الايام خصوصا الاعمال التاليه: 1 - صومها جميعا: فقد اخرج احمد والنساءي عن حفصه بنت عمر رضي الله عنهما قالت: «اربع لم يكن يدعهن رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم صيام عاشوراء والعشر وثلاثه ايام من كل شهر والركعتين قبل الغداه.» والمقصود ما عدا يوم العيد فلا يحل صومه، ولذلك اخرج ابو داوو د عن بعض ازواج النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم قالت: «كان النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم يصوم تسع ذي الحجه ويوم عاشوراء وثلاثه ايام من كل شهر واول اثنين من الشهر والخميس.» واما حديث عاءشه عند مسلم: «ما رايت رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم صاءما في العشر قط .» فمحمول علي الحج. 2 - صوم يوم عرفه بخصوصه لغير الحاج: فقد اخرج مسلم واحمد وابو داوو د وابن ماجه عن ابي قتاده رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم: «صوم يوم عرفه يكفر سنتين ماضيه و مستقبله و صوم يوم عاشوراء يكفر سنه ماضيه.» وفي لفظ: «احتسب علي الله ان يكفر السنه التي قبله و السنه التي بعده.» 3 - الاكثار من الذكر: فقد قال البخاري في الصحيح: «وقال ابن عباس: ﴿ويذكروا اسم الله في ايام معلومات﴾ ايام العشر. قال: وكان ابن عمر وابو هريره يخرجان الي السوق في ايام العشر يكبران ويكبر الناس بتكبيرهما.» وقد سبق في حديث ابن عمر الاكثار من التهليل والتكبير والتحميد. 4 - عدم اخذ المضحي من شعره واظافره من بدايه الشهر حتي يضحي تشبها بالمحرم: فقد اخرج الجماعه الا البخاري من حديث ام سلمه رضي الله عنها ان رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم قال: «من كان له ذبح يذبحه فاذا اهل هلال ذي الحجه فلا ياخذن من شعره واظافره حتي يضحي.» والله يوفقنا واياكم لكل خير ويتقبل منا ومنكم. كتبه محمد الحسن بن الددو كان الله له وليا ونصيرا

t: Sheikh al-Dedew Delivers an Address at the Opening of the Sixth Conference of the Kuala Lumpur Forum for Thought and Civilisation
a: الشيخ الددو يلقي كلمه في افتتاح المءتمر السادس لمنتدي كوالالمبور للفكر والحضاره
b: this morning, 11-12-2022, in the turkish capital istanbul, the proceedings of the sixth conference of the kuala lumpur forum for thought and civilisation opened under the banner "civilisational resumption and the projects of revival in the islamic ummah (roots — present reality — future)", with the participation of his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew, deputy president of the forum, his eminence dr abderrazak makri, secretary-general of the forum, and a great throng of the ummah's scholars, its thinkers and the leaders of its renaissance. the conference was opened with a fragrant recitation from the wise remembrance, followed by a video presenting the forum, then the address of the secretary-general and the address of the deputy president, and a video about the forum's achievements. the forum's secretary-general, his eminence dr abderrazak makri, gave an address in which he welcomed those attending and spoke about the foremost obstacles facing the ummah at the present time and how they are to be overcome. for his part, his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew, deputy president of the forum, spoke about the challenges the ummah has faced, and about what the sons of the ummah are obliged to do for the sake of its renaissance and its advancement and the repelling of injustice from it; his eminence then spoke about the fall of the caliphate, the scattering of the ummah, the occupation of its lands and the ascendancy of the western powers over it. he also called upon those who work for reform to occupy themselves with upbringing and with knowledge, with reconciling people to one another, with helping others past their stumbles, and with casting off discord. the opening ceremony also included the presentation of a number of plaques and certificates of appreciation to the figures and bodies taking part in the ummah's renaissance and the defence of its causes. the conference continues for three days, in which the participants discuss projects for the ummah's revival, so as to put forward a set of recommendations and proposals such as would raise up the ummah and contribute to its renaissance.
r: افتتحت صباح اليوم 11 -12 – 2022م -بالعاصمه التركيه استنطبول - اشغال المءتمر السادس لمنتدي كوالالمبور للفكر والحضاره، تحت شعار " الاستءناف الحضاري ومشاريع الاحياء في الامه الاسلاميه (الجذور – الواقع – المستقبل)" وذلك بمشاركه فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو ناءب رءيس المنتدي وفضيله الدكتور عبد الرزاق مقري الامين العام للمنتدي وجمع غفير من علماء الامه ومفكريها وقاده نهضتها. وقد افتتح المءتمر بتلاوه عطره من الذكر الحكيم تلاها عرض فيديو تعريفي بالمنتدي، ثم كلمه الامين العام وكلمه ناءب الرءيس، وعرض فيديو عن منجزات المنتدي. الامين العام للمنتدي فضيله د. عبد الرزاق مقري القي كلمه رحب فيها بالحضور متحدثا عن ابرز العقبات التي تواجه الامه في الوقت الراهن وكيفيه تجاوزها. من جانبه تحدث فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو ناءب رءيس المنتدي عما واجهته الامه من تحديات، وما يجب علي ابناء الامه فعله في سبيل نهضتها ورقيها ودفع الظلم عنها ثم تحدث فضيلته عن سقوط الخلافه وتشتت الامه واحتلال بلدانها وتغلب القوي الغربيه عليها. كما دعا الي اشتغال المصلحين بالتربيه والعلم واصلاح ذات البين واقاله العثرات ونبذ الخلاف. كما تخلل حفل الافتتاح تقديم عدد من الدروع وشهادات التقدير للشخصيات والجهات المشاركه في نهضه الامه والدفاع عن قضاياها. هذا ويستمر المءتمر لثلاثه ايام يناقش المشاركون فيه مشاريع احياء الامه، ليقدموا مجموعه من التوصيات والمقترحات التي من شانها ان ترفع بالامه وتساهم في نهضتها.

t: Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures in Hodh ech Chargui as Part of His Da'wah Programme in Eastern Mauritania
a: الشيخ الددو يحاضر في الحوض الشرقي ضمن برنامجه الدعوي في الشرق الموريتاني
b:
at midday yesterday, monday 11 september 2023, in the district of néma, his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew delivered his fourth lecture within his eminence's da'wah programme, speaking about the muslim's responsibility towards his religion and its sanctities,
explaining that the muslim is answerable before god for the message of muhammad, god bless him and grant him peace; that he is under trial in this life; and that he is required to defend his religion and the honour of his messenger.
he affirmed that when the philosophers of the west proved unable to corrupt the muslim's creed (ʿaqīdah) and to weaken his love for his prophet, god bless him and grant him peace, and his attachment to him, they wanted him to live for his appetites, keeping away from his religion and from his relationship with his lord; and that they therefore devised a set of theories calling for the casting off of religions, for attachment to matter, for war on sound natural disposition (fiṭrah), and for the spreading of gross indecencies.
this lecture comes within the da'wah programme organised by the al-mustaqbal association for da'wah, culture and education.
this programme takes in a set of scholarly and da'wah lectures calling for the purification of the human soul (tazkiyah), urging noble character, and the necessity that a person occupy himself with what secures for him the good of both the hereafter and this life.
this programme comes within the da'wah plan of the president of the al-mustaqbal association, his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew.
his eminence had opened his da'wah programme with a lecture in the town of aghchorguitt on the evening of last saturday, 9 september 2023.
the programme included a visit of condolence to his eminence sheikh ahmad jiddou ould ahmad bahi, deputy chairman of the association's consultative council, in the village of boukhzama, which the sheikh reached on monday night before delivering two lectures to the people of the village. the first of them was on the necessity that the muslim provide himself with provision for the abode of the hereafter, citing his saying, god bless him and grant him peace, "death is sufficient as an admonisher"; and in the second lecture he urged them to preserve their values, to compete in acts of obedience, and to take as their model the master of all creation, god bless him and grant him peace.
his eminence also delivered a lecture in the town of timbedra last night, in which he spoke about the character of the muslim, and what he ought to be in this world by way of shrewdness, alertness and putting god's command first; and he went over the story of the companions of the cave and their faith in god and their sacrifice in his path, exalted is he.
the programme is expected to include further lectures in each of oualata, tintane, kiffa and kouro.
r: القي فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو ظهر امس الاثنين - 11 سبتمبر 2023م - بمقاطعه النعمه محاضرته الرابعه ضمن البرنامج الدعوي لفضيلته، وقد تحدث عن مسءوليه المسلم تجاه دينه ومقدساته مبينا ان المسلم مسءول امام الله عن رساله محمد صلي الله عليه وسلم، وهو ممتحن في هذه الحياه، ومطالب بالدفاع عن دينه وعرض رسوله. مءكدا ان فلاسفه الغرب لما عجزوا عن افساد عقيده المسلم واضعاف حبه وتعلقه بنبيه صلي الله عليه وسلم ارادوه ان يعيش لغراءزه مبتعدا عن دينه وعلاقته بربه؛ لذلك استحدثوا مجموعه من النظريات الداعيه الي نبذ الاديان، والتعلق بالماده، ومحاربه الفطره السليمه، واشاعه الفواحش. وتاتي هذه المحاضره ضمن البرنامج الدعوي الذي تنظمه جمعيه المستقبل للدعوه والثقافه والتعليم. ويشمل هذا البرنامج مجموعه من المحاضرات العلميه والدعويه الداعيه الي تزكيه النفس البشريه والحث علي مكارم الاخلاق وضروره انشغال الانسان بما يضمن له حسنتي المعاد والمعاش. وياتي هذا البرنامج ضمن الخطه الدعويه لرءيس جمعيه المستقبل فضيله الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو وكان فضيلته قد افتتح برنامجه الدعوي بمحاضره بمدينه اغشوركيت مساء السبت الماضي 09 سبتمبر 2023م وقد تضمن البرنامج تعزيه لفضيله الشيخ احمد جدو ولد احمد باهي ناءب رءيس مجلس شوري الجمعيه بقريه بوخزامه التي وصل اليها الشيخ ليله الاثنين قبل ان يلقي محاضرتين لسكان القريه كانت اولاهما عن ضروره تزود المسلم للدار الاخره مستشهدا بحديثه صلي الله عليه وسلم " كفي بالموت واعظا "، وحثهم في المحاضره الثانيه علي المحافظه علي القيم، والمنافسه في الطاعات، والاقتداء بسيد الخلق اجمعين صلي الله عليه وسلم كما القي فضيلته محاضره في مدينه تمبدغه الليله الماضيه تحدث فيها عن خلق المسلم، ومايجب ان يكون عليه في هذه الدنيا من الفطنه واليقظه وتقديم امر الله، كما استعرض قصه اصحاب الكهف وايمانهم الله، وتضحيتهم في سبيله تعالي. ومن المنتظر ان يتضمن البرنامج محاضرات اخري في كل من ولعيون والطينطان وكيفه وكرو.

t: From Muhammad al-Hasan ibn al-Dedew to Every Muslim Whom This Reaches
a: من محمد الحسن بن الددو الي كل من يصل اليه من المسلمين
b:
peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.
to proceed: among the best seasons of good in the year is this season with which god has favoured you in these days of merit, which are the best days of the year. the group narrated — except muslim and al-nasa'i — from the hadith of ibn abbas, may god be pleased with them both, who said: the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, said: «there are no days in which righteous deeds are more beloved to god, mighty and majestic, than these days» — meaning the ten days of dhu al-hijjah. and ahmad and others narrated from the hadith of ibn umar, may god be pleased with them both, who said: the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, said: «there are no days greater in the sight of god, glorified is he, nor in which deeds are more beloved to him, than these ten days; so do much in them of declaring god's oneness, of declaring his greatness and of praising him.» so exert yourselves in righteous deeds in these days, and especially in the following:

1 - fasting all of them. ahmad and al-nasa'i narrated from hafsa bint umar, may god be pleased with them both, who said: «four things the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, did not leave: the fast of ashura, the ten days, three days of every month, and the two cycles before the morning meal.» what is meant is all but the day of eid, for fasting it is not lawful. for this reason abu dawud narrated from one of the wives of the prophet, god bless him and grant him peace, who said: «the prophet, god bless him and grant him peace, used to fast the nine days of dhu al-hijjah, the day of ashura, three days of every month, and the first monday of the month, and the thursdays.» as for the hadith of aisha with muslim: «i never saw the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, fasting in the ten days at all.» — that is to be understood as referring to the hajj.
2 - fasting the day of arafah in particular, for one who is not on hajj. muslim, ahmad, abu dawud and ibn majah narrated from abu qatada, may god be pleased with him, who said: the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, said: «fasting the day of arafah expiates two years, one past and one to come; and fasting the day of ashura expiates one past year.» and in another wording: «i reckon upon god that he will expiate the year before it and the year after it.»
3 - doing much remembrance of god. al-bukhari said in the ṣaḥīḥ: «and ibn abbas said: {and that they may mention the name of god on the appointed days} (sūrat al-ḥajj 22:28) — the days of the ten. he said: and ibn umar and abu hurayra used to go out to the market during the days of the ten, declaring god's greatness, and the people would declare his greatness at their declaring it.» and there has already come, in the hadith of ibn umar, the instruction to do much of declaring god's oneness, declaring his greatness and praising him.
